SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.
The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) charged eight Colorado-based entities Thursday, alleging they used fake crypto trading platforms to take $37.4 million from more than 1,500 US investors.
Four of the defendants posed as investment advisers, and each steered investors to a fake trading platform run by its partner, according to the SEC’s complaint. The four pairs operated in succession from August 2024 to May 2026.
The defendants allegedly lured investors by masquerading as investment advisers or representatives of crypto asset trading platforms, which the SEC described as fronts designed to steal investor money, the agency announced in a Thursday press release.
The SEC said the operators were likely overseas and used social media ads to lure investors into private chat groups. They first offered stock-trading advice before persuading victims to transfer money to fake crypto platforms, where victims believed they were buying genuine crypto assets.
The SEC previously warned investors that scammers used investment-related group chats to promote fraud schemes, including by impersonating financial professionals, according to a December 2025 alert.
The scheme allegedly operated through four successive adviser-platform pairs from August 2024 to May 2026, with operators switching pairs every few months.
The eight entities charged were Advisor WeChat Capital, Tech Brokerage Asset Alliance Ltd., HB Wealth Advisors, IdeaCrypto Exchange LLC, Convergent Wealth Advisors Inc., RealSimple Crypto Exchange Inc., Associated Wealth Advisors Ltd., and Essential Crypto Exchange.
“The SEC continues to seek out and expose fraudulent investment scams that prey on U.S. investors,” said Laura D’Allaird, chief of the SEC Enforcement Division’s Cyber and Emerging Technologies Unit, encouraging the public to report such schemes through its online portal.
During fiscal year 2026, the SEC filed 348 enforcement actions, down 23.7% from 456 a year earlier. The SEC filed 13 crypto-related actions in calendar year 2025, down from 33 in 2024, according to Cornerstone Research.

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- An Abu Dhabi court ordered 18 firms to keep tokens tied to the Binance theft frozen.
- The Dec. 1 hearing will consider whether the freeze should continue and on what terms.
- Tether says it will work separately with Binance and the relevant authorities on reissuing frozen USDT.
An Abu Dhabi court has ordered Circle and 17 other companies to keep tokens linked to Binance’s Oct. 29 theft frozen while the exchange tries to recover them.
Binance disclosed the order on Nov. 18 and said some issuers, exchanges and other partners ask for a court order before they will release or transfer assets they have frozen.
The exchange said the order from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts helps open that route, describing ongoing efforts to trace the stolen funds and giving no details of any transfer under the order.
What the Dec. 1 hearing could change for Binance
The named firms include Circle, which issues USDC, and World Liberty Financial, the company behind USD1.
Reports noted that the firms must maintain the freezes pending further proceedings and cannot lend, swap, or mix the affected tokens with other assets.
The court did not accuse the firms of wrongdoing, and Dec. 1 is scheduled to consider whether to keep the injunction in place and on what terms.
The injunction covers specific assets Binance claimed are tied to the theft, and said it is still tracing the stolen crypto and taking legal steps to reclaim it. A transfer for firms seeking a court order depends on whether they have authority to release the specific balances they have frozen.
Tether falls outside the order covering the 18 firms, and the company said on Nov. 2 it had frozen more than $1.5 billion tied to the theft.
A spokesperson said Tether would work directly with Binance to reissue the tokens, in consultation with the relevant authorities.
The Abu Dhabi order follows earlier US court action. On Nov. 12, the US Justice Department said it had obtained court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in stolen crypto. That was part of more than $2.7 billion that US authorities and private firms had helped freeze.
In its Nov. 3 incident report, Binance estimated that about $6.3 billion in digital assets were affected and about $2.85 billion was frozen or intercepted, subject to reconciliation and market prices.
The separate disclosures do not establish how much the figures overlap or how much Binance can ultimately recover. Binance says it absorbed the financial impact on customers while continuing to pursue the stolen assets.
items.title: Circle and Trump-linked crypto firm hit with court freeze order after Binance’s $6.3 billion hack

美股科技股面临2022年熊市以来最大考验，标普500六周市值缩水超6万亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，据 BIT 股票平台数据显示，美股周四高开低走，标普 500 指数收跌 2.02%，报 7175.83 点，连续第六个交易日下跌，较 10 月 6 日收盘高点回撤约 8.2%，逾九成标普 500 成分股下跌。纳斯达克综合指数收跌 2.25%，Anthropic 上市首日收报 97.17 美元，较发行价上涨 17.1%，Anthropic 上市未能缓解 AI 相关忧虑，英伟达由盘中一度涨 4.7% 转为收跌 3.3%。

多只科技股较历史高点大幅回落，其中 CoreWeave（CRWV）回撤 76.0%，甲骨文（ORCL）回撤 68.0%，闪迪（SNDK）回撤 67.9%，Nebius（NBIS）回撤 67.7%，西部数据（WDC）回撤 62.9%，英特尔（INTC）和 Arm（ARM）均回撤 60.9%。Marvell（MRVL）回撤 58.0%、Robinhood（HOOD）回撤 55.4%、希捷（STX）回撤 54.5%。此外，美光（MU）回撤 45.0%，英伟达（NVDA）回撤 40.0%，SpaceX（SPCX）回撤 38.7%，高通（QCOM）回撤 37.7%。

The Kobeissi Letter 认为，科技股正面临 2022 年熊市以来最大考验，标普 500 自 10 月 6 日高点以来约六周内对应市值缩水逾 6 万亿美元。纳斯达克 100 指数成分股当月迄今市值合计缩水约 2 万亿美元。嘉信理财衍生品研究与策略主管 Nathan Peterson 表示，尽管 AI 股短线已出现超卖迹象，投资者仍倾向于逢反弹卖出，目前尚难确认抛售已到尾声。

机构对中期走势并未一致转空。摩根士丹利首席美国股票策略师 Mike Wilson 表示，标普 500 年底前可能再探 7100 至 7300 点，但他将这轮下跌视为牛市中的调整，而非牛市终结，并将未来 12 个月目标上调至 8700 点。高盛研究则预计，标普 500 到 2027 年底的总回报约为 18%；但随着 AI 资本支出增速放缓、折旧费用上升，明年的回报将更多依赖企业盈利增长，而非估值扩张。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 生图公司 Ideogram 发布 4.6 模型，支持原生 4K 图像生成，无需后期放大。相比上一代原生 2K，人物皮肤的毛孔、细纹，以及布料、金属等材质的细节更加丰富。

新版本继续强化 Ideogram 4.5 主打的精准编辑能力。比如只想改变一件衣服的颜色，AI 就尽量不碰人物面部和背景。即使连续修改多次，也能减少画面其他区域的颜色、纹理和细节偏移。

按照官方同条件测试，模型将物体改成指定色号的可用率，从上一代的 46% 提升至 83%；修复商品照片细节的可用率从 61% 提升至 86%；仅修改指定区域的可用率从 82% 提升至 90%。

在 Rapidata 多轮图像编辑榜单上，Ideogram 4.6 以 1892 分排名第一，领先字节 Seedream 5.5 和 FLUX 3 Image。该评测让模型对 199 张真人照片连续进行 5 次编辑，再由人工判断人物面部是否保持原样。

目前模型已在 Ideogram 应用、API 和多个合作平台上线。API 最高画质下，原生 4K 生成每张 0.20 美元，4K 编辑每张 0.60 美元。

🔍  链上侦探 |  门罗币桥接资产XMR1脱锚：某做市商再接下356万抛盘，四天前便曾被Lighter涉事资金扫走逾半

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，11 月 20 日，Hyperliquid 上的门罗币桥接资产 XMR1 一度从约 479 美元闪崩至 1 美元附近。逐笔成交记录显示，疑似做市地址 0x4c6d 在下跌初段挂单承接了约 355.67 万美元抛盘；而就在四天前，同一地址曾站在卖方，为 Lighter 被盗后流入 Hyperliquid 的资金提供了逾半数 XMR1。

今日抛盘来源：部署地址转出 520 万枚代币，0x1464 砸盘后换入 1322 万美元 ETH

今日的集中抛售有独立可查的链上来源。地址 0x1464 分三笔从 XMR1 部署地址收到 520 万枚代币，随即在 Hyperliquid 集中抛售。

12:49 起，0x4c6d 以 469.67 美元均价累计买入约 406.36 万 USDC 的 XMR1，其中 46 笔由 0x1464 主动砸入其买单。

抛售完成后，卖方迅速转向 ETH——北京时间 12:57 至 13:19，0x1464 在 Arbitrum 通过 CoW Swap 分 10 笔花费 1322.38 万 USDC，买入 7467.32 枚 ETH（均价 1770.90 美元）

两度站上对手盘？疑似做市对冲机制撞上桥接币脱锚

0x4c6d 的历史交易记录解释了其为何频繁现身大额对手盘。早在 10 月 30 日，该地址便曾在同一秒内通过五笔挂单买入 243.55 枚 XMR1，下一秒即按五笔完全相同的数量卖出 XMR 永续合约，呈现典型的跨市场做市/套利对冲特征。

今日在 469.67 美元附近接货时，该地址再次同步卖出 XMR 永续合约，将原有多仓翻为空仓。但由于本轮下跌源于桥接资产异动而非原生币种回调，传统对冲逻辑失效——原生 XMR 仍维持在约 472 美元，其手中接下的桥接币 XMR1 成交价却已跌至 1 美元附近，面临严重的脱锚亏损风险。

四天前：曾或被迫为 Lighter 涉事资金提供 55.68% 的 XMR1 卖盘

就在四天前，同一疑似做市地址还曾承接过 Lighter 事件的异常买盘。11 月 16 日，Lighter 交易账户遭盗，约 1039 万 USDC 被转出（另约 509 万 USDC 随后被追回）。

Bitquery 追踪显示，部分被盗资金经 12 个地址在 Hyperliquid 花费约 346.12 万 USDC 买入 XMR1；按成交编号比对，其中 9 个地址通过 45 笔交易，从 0x4c6d 挂出的卖单中买走 3721.48 枚，成交约 192.73 万 USDC，占该批资金买入额的 55.68%。

谷歌员工把唱衰DeepMind的报告放桌上天天看，三个月后SemiAnalysis道歉，承认自己当初看走眼了

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌 Gemini 强化学习团队成员 Arthur Douillard 透露，他们把 SemiAnalysis 那篇唱衰 DeepMind 的报告打印出来，摆在办公桌上天天看。外界都觉得他们已经掉队，再也追不上了，他们偏要憋着一口气证明对方看错了。

这篇报告发表于今年 8 月，标题叫《Gemini is Cooked but GCP is Cooking》。当时 SemiAnalysis 认为，DeepMind 的顶尖人才大量出走，谷歌云又抢走了大量算力，模型研发已经跟不上 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。甚至直接断言：DeepMind 已经不算顶尖 AI 实验室，基本不可能再追上第一梯队了。

结果才过了三个多月，谷歌连续发布 Gemini 4 Argon、Carbon、Hydrogen 和 Neon 四款模型。Carbon 一度登顶 Artificial Analysis 综合智能榜，最新的 Neon 综合排名世界第三，编程智能体评测更是拿下第一，略微超过 Claude Fable 5.2，完成任务的平均成本还不到后者的一半。

Arthur 特意发帖感谢 SemiAnalysis：「谢谢你们提供的动力。文章里说的那些问题，当时确实存在，但时代已经变了。」

SemiAnalysis 这回也服软了，直接晒出一张「谷歌道歉表」，给自己勾选了好几条犯错理由，包括「只看了 X」「没读模型卡」，甚至还有「水星逆行」。最后承认自己看错了 Gemini 4。

DeepMind 创始人哈萨比斯也亲自下场接梗：「道歉收下了！不过你们漏勾了一项：低估了这支超强的 Google DeepMind 团队。」

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Spectra’s Nov. 19 overview showed $2.77 million of liquidity for the Nov. 26 maturity and far less in the two later pools.
- Rolling into a later principal token requires a new trade, so position size can change the yield a holder can lock in.
- Firelight’s withdrawal route currently takes 30 to 60 days, after which holders can claim FXRP and separately redeem it for native XRP.
A Spectra pool tied to Firelight’s XRP yield strategy had roughly $2.8 million in liquidity on Nov. 19, one week before its principal tokens became redeemable on Nov. 26.
The two later maturities in the same Spectra overview had about $51,000 and $13,000, so holders seeking another fixed rate would have to trade in a much smaller pool.
The gap was visible in Spectra’s market overview on Nov. 19, which shows that its later pools mature on Dec. 31 and March 31, 2027. The first question for Spectra holders at maturity is which token the position can deliver on Flare.
Maturity and rollover on Spectra
Firelight takes FXRP, the representation of XRP on the Flare network, and issues stXRP shares in its vault. On Spectra, a buyer can purchase a principal token at a discount and redeem it at maturity.
This November series has its own market on Flare, which lists stXRP as the default input or output and FXRP as the underlying asset.
At maturity, Spectra holders can open their positions to see the available redemption token and estimated proceeds. Spectra’s redemption guide shows the underlying payout is normally close to one unit per principal token, with a lower rate possible if the strategy suffers a loss.
Spectra’s contracts also support redemption in the interest-bearing token. In that case, the output also depends on the conversion rate. For this series, the market labels identify the two assets, and the position’s redemption quote determines the available route and amount.
The pool’s $2.8 million counts the value on both sides of the market, stXRP and principal tokens. The amount redeemed at maturity depends on the principal token holders present and the rate the contract applies.
Spectra’s Nov. 19 overview at 12:29 UTC showed $2.77M, $51K and $13K in two-sided liquidity for the three listed Firelight stXRP pools.
Spectra’s overview showed fixed rates of 5.21% for November, 7.56% for December, and 8.01% for March. The yield earned between purchase and maturity depends on the price paid and the time left. A rollover is a new trade, so its terms depend on what a later pool quotes for that order.
The December market held roughly $36,400 in principal tokens and $14,400 in stXRP as of Nov. 19. A buyer taking principal tokens from the pool would have to price that trade against the available inventory.
How a holder gets back to native XRP
A holder who receives stXRP can swap the shares for FXRP at a market price. The amount received depends on the trade quote, which can differ from the Firelight vault’s share value.
Both the swap and the rollover depend on what the market will fill for a given amount of stXRP. Meanwhile, Firelight’s unstaking process records the share value in FXRP when the holder requests a withdrawal and ends reward accrual at that point.
The FXRP becomes withdrawable at the end of the next coverage period, currently 30 to 60 days after the request, and the holder must submit a second transaction to claim it. During the wait, claims tied to capital-backed coverage can still reduce the payout.
FAssets redemption burns FXRP on Flare and has an agent send native XRP to the holder’s XRP Ledger address.
The redemption request sets the payment deadline, and applicable fees reduce the amount the agent sends.
After Nov. 26, redemptions on the maturing contract can show how many principal token holders actually redeem, while trades and liquidity in the later Spectra pools can show whether those markets draw renewed activity.
Firelight unstake requests and FAssets payment confirmations mark further steps toward native XRP.

Former SEC Chair: AI Bubble Could Burst Before the 2028 Election

On November 16, former SEC Chair Gary Gensler said in an interview with CNN that the AI bubble could burst before the 2028 U.S. presidential election, with a correction potentially comparable to the 2001 dot-com bust, though unlikely to be as severe as the 2008 financial crisis. The U.S. currently spends approximately 2.5% of its GDP annually on AI infrastructure. He noted that the railroad, electricity, and internet industries all experienced similar cycles of investment booms and contractions, while the rapid pace of lending today could further amplify the risks. (During his tenure as SEC Chair from 2021 to 2025, Gensler took a tough regulatory stance toward the cryptocurrency industry and pushed the SEC to take enforcement actions against major crypto firms such as Coinbase and Binance.) — link

items.content:
Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.
Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on its Nasdaq debut Thursday, but their net purchases totaled just $60 million, about half the $118 million they put into SpaceX on its first day of trading in June.
Anthropic’s first-day retail trading volume topped SpaceX’s $669 million and was the highest for any market debut in Vanda Research’s data, which go back to 2012, Yahoo Finance reported.
Volume counts both purchases and sales, while net buying measures how much purchases exceeded sales.
The Claude AI developer and its existing shareholders offered 980 million shares at $83 each in the $81.34 billion initial public offering (IPO). Anthropic shares opened on Nasdaq at $111.50 on Thursday, 34.3% above the IPO price, and closed at $97.17 for a first-day gain of 17.1%.
SpaceX shares gained 19.2% in their June 12 debut, closing at $160.95 against an IPO price of $135, according to Nasdaq. Although Anthropic’s base offering exceeded SpaceX’s initial $75 billion sale, SpaceX ultimately raised $85.7 billion after underwriters exercised their option to purchase additional shares.
Before the IPO, Vanda forecast about $250 million in net retail buying, more than four times Thursday’s total. Its forecast drew on retail trading in past market debuts and the volume of Anthropic perpetual futures traded on decentralized exchange Hyperliquid.
Shortly before Nasdaq trading began, those futures traded at $110.48, just 0.9% below the stock’s opening price.
Related: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100

Bitunix分析师：流动性收缩席卷加密与贵金属，市场进入现金优先阶段

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，BTC 自 11 月 19 日约 63,665 美元高点回落至 61,700 美元附近，24 小时爆仓达 6.51 亿美元，未平仓量下降 2.7%，显示去杠杆持续。现货与合约 CVD 同步卖出，主动卖出占比约 51%；下方 61,250 至 61,400 美元仍有承接，60,550 至 60,600 美元则是重要买盘区，盘面尚未完全失去防守能力。

更值得注意的是，黄金同步连跌五日，本周跌幅可能超过 9%，较历史高点 5596 美元回落逾 2000 美元。当美国通膨黏性推升升息预期、美元与美债殖利率走高，加上 AI 科技股遭遇抛售，投资人开始筹集现金，年底流动性需求更放大跌势。黄金未能在风险情绪恶化时发挥避险作用，反映当前市场优先考量资金周转与杠杆风险，而非单纯寻找防御性资产。

BTC 与黄金同步走弱，说明目前压制市场的核心是资金成本及流动性，而非单一资产基本面恶化。Hyperliquid 超级印钞机 BTC 空单达 7.78 亿美元、多单仅 9403 万美元，空头集中也提高支撑区反弹时的回补风险。短线 BTC 若失守 61,250 美元，将进一步测试 60,600 及 60,000 美元；若重新站回 62,265 至 62,720 美元并伴随 CVD 改善，则需留意空头挤压。市场仍处于资金收缩与杠杆重新分配阶段，反弹能否持续取决于买盘是否真正回流。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Gemini Mac 客户端正式加入 Computer Use（电脑操作）功能。现在 Gemini 可以直接操作电脑上的软件和网站，自己点击按钮、输入文字、切换菜单、填写表单，完成跨应用的复杂任务。

items.content:
Serenity：市场或误读中国企业级SSD采购放缓，NAND需求并未结构性恶化

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，Serenity 发文表示，市场可能错误地将中国企业级 SSD 采购削减解读为需求恶化和 NAND 供应过剩。群联电子（Phison）CEO 最新评论及 TrendForce 的相关数据表明，中国云服务商近期采购放缓，主要受到 GPU 短缺及预付款需求影响，而非 AI 存储需求出现结构性下滑。

具体来看，中国企业级 SSD 需求自 2026 年 11 月起放缓，主要原因是 GPU 供应不足，部分企业在缺少 GPU 的情况下减少服务器组件采购，甚至通过现货市场出售部分服务器零部件回笼资金。同时，中国大型云服务商计划大规模预付 GPU 采购款，暂时占用了资金，导致其他组件采购延后。

Serenity 认为，此前确实出现了订单削减，但本质上属于采购时间错配和订单延期，并不意味着长期需求减弱。群联 CEO 也指出，2027 年的主要挑战可能仍是供应不足而非需求疲软，AI 基础设施短缺甚至可能推动企业进一步提前采购和积累库存。

此外，群联目前的库存不足以满足其对 2027 年需求的预期，并将当前市场环境视为积累 NAND 库存的机会。Serenity 认为，市场对 SNDK 和铠侠近期下跌的解读可能过于悲观，中国 AI 基础设施的瓶颈实际上正在重新转向 GPU 供应。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378364
items.title: Serenity：市场或误读中国企业级SSD采购放缓，NAND需求并未结构性恶化

items.content:
美联储保尔森：清晰指引可稳定利率预期，帮助市场理解政策调整方向

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，费城联储主席安娜·保尔森周四表示，清晰的政策沟通有助于稳定市场利率预期，使美联储能够根据经济数据灵活调整货币政策，而不必提前承诺具体的利率路径。

保尔森指出，美联储沟通的重点应是让市场理解央行的政策反应机制，即如何根据通胀、就业及经济增长情况作出决策。充分的政策沟通能够引导消费和投资预期，减少金融市场不必要的波动，同时保留美联储应对经济变化的政策灵活性。

针对美联储主席沃什推动的沟通机制改革，保尔森强调，美联储应保留多种沟通渠道，包括季度利率预测点阵图，让市场获得足够信息来判断未来政策方向。

保尔森同时表示，她支持美联储 10 月维持利率不变的决定，认为市场并未将暂停加息误解为加息周期结束。对于 12 月会议，她尚未给出明确的利率预测。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378363

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Robotaxi services revenue reached $17.8 million, including passenger fares and vehicle deliveries to joint deployments.
- The company says fares covered tracked vehicle costs in Guangzhou and Shenzhen, without giving margin percentages.
- Riders can book between Nansha and central Guangzhou in a service area the company says exceeds 1,000 square kilometers.
Pony.ai’s robotaxi fare revenue nearly quintupled year over year in the September quarter, while the company-wide operating loss narrowed to $68.7 million from $69.7 million.
In its Nov. 18 filing, Pony.ai said fare revenue rose nearly 400% year over year. Revenue from its broader robotaxi services business grew 165.4% to $17.8 million from $6.7 million, helped by both passenger fares and higher vehicle deliveries to joint deployments in China and overseas.
In a November service update, separate from its September-quarter figures, Pony.ai said the previously separate operating zones in central Guangzhou and Nansha formed one contiguous area of more than 1,000 square kilometers as of Nov. 17.
Riders can use its PonyPilot app to book trips between Nansha and central Guangzhou, where Pony.ai holds a citywide commercial permit. The area it measured in November covers the connected operating zones where the company says those bookings are available.
CEO James Peng said PonyPilot now lets riders book across Nansha, Haizhu, Tianhe, Huangpu and Panyu. He said the wider network had increased trip distances and the average price per ride in Guangzhou.
What fares cover in Guangzhou and Shenzhen
On the November earnings call, CFO Leo Wang reported that Pony.ai’s fleets in Guangzhou and Shenzhen had earned enough in fares to more than cover the vehicle costs Pony.ai includes in its calculation.
Pony.ai starts with fares after discounts and refunds, then deducts vehicle depreciation, charging, wages for remote and ground staff, cleaning and maintenance, insurance, parking and communications.
Wang said depreciation accounts for about half of those costs. It covers the vehicle, including the battery and the hardware used to drive it autonomously.
The company said premiums per seventh-generation robotaxi fell 19% from a year earlier at renewal, giving no profit margin for an individual ride.
Across Pony.ai’s robotaxi, robotruck and intelligent solutions businesses, quarterly revenue rose 75.2% to $44.6 million. The reported operating loss fell from 273.9% of revenue to 154.2%, even as the dollar loss narrowed by about $1 million.
Pony.ai’s expansion will test whether more fleets can cover the vehicle costs it tracks as it works to reduce its company-wide loss.
items.title: Pony AI’s robotaxi fares surge nearly 400% but its operating losses barely budge

Anthropic七位创始人IPO套现近19.5亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，Anthropic 于周四正式上市，IPO 总募资规模达 813 亿美元，其中七位联合创始人合计套现 19.5 亿美元。按照每股 83 美元的 IPO 定价计算，每位创始人出售约 340 万股，套现约 2.8 亿美元，较此前预期的每人 2.5 亿美元高出约 3000 万美元。

Anthropic 此前在 IPO 文件中表示，七位创始人均承诺将个人持有的公司股权的 80% 用于慈善事业，但该承诺属于自愿且可撤销的意向，并不具有法律约束力。此次 IPO 还有几项关键数据：

- 1048 亿美元：Anthropic 实际募资总额，包括公开发行股票及向大型科技公司发行的 260 亿美元无投票权 N 类股票。若承销商全额行使超额配售权，募资规模可能达到 1170 亿美元。

- 28%：谷歌和亚马逊合计持有 Anthropic 约 28% 的股份，分别占股 13.4% 和 14.6%。

- 1.05 万亿至 1.08 万亿美元：Anthropic 已披露的未来基础设施承诺总额。其中，仅未来 12 个月的算力及基础设施支出承诺就达到 707 亿美元，2030 年底前相关承诺达到 4516 亿美元。

此外，英伟达和谷歌分别认购 100 亿美元 N 类股票，AMD、博通、美光、微软和台积电认购剩余部分。尽管此次 IPO 募资规模创纪录，但 Anthropic 未来仍面临超过万亿美元的基础设施投入需求。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378362

黄金连续第五个交易日下跌，较历史高点回落超2000美元，本周跌幅或超9%

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，周五现货黄金盘中一度暴跌超 2.8%，逼近 3520 美元/盎司，本周累计跌幅可能超过 9%，创 2025 年 9 月以来新低；现货白银本周下跌约 15%，纽约期银周五亚盘一度扩大跌幅至 7%。

本轮抛售主要受到三方面因素冲击：一是美联储官员释放鹰派信号，加息预期升温，美债收益率和美元走高，削弱黄金吸引力；二是 AI 股票抛售潮蔓延至全球市场，投资者出售黄金筹集现金；三是年底流动性需求增加，进一步加剧贵金属抛压。

自 2 月底美伊战争爆发以来，能源成本上涨加剧通胀压力，黄金已较年初创下的 5596 美元/盎司历史高点下跌超 2000 美元，年内跌幅扩大至 16%。

Global X ETFs 策略师 Justin Lin 表示，黄金目前在 3300 至 3400 美元区域之前缺乏明显技术支撑。金鹏期货总经理喻猛国则认为，本轮下跌本质上是市场对通胀黏性和美联储加息预期的重新定价，并非黄金信用逻辑发生变化。

美国机构第三季度增持 49,229 枚 BTC，富国银行跃居比特币 ETF 最大机构持有者

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，Galaxy Research 最新报告显示，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，美国机构投资者通过 13F 文件披露的现货比特币 ETP 持仓达到 356,491 枚 BTC，创历史新高，较上一季度增加 49,229 枚 BTC，扭转此前连续三个季度净减持趋势。

其中，富国银行增持 14,636 枚 BTC，持仓升至 30,553 枚 BTC，超过 Jane Street 的 23,167 枚 BTC，成为最大机构持有者。Brevan Howard、美国银行和 Millennium Management 分别增持 8,606 枚、7,201 枚和 7,114 枚 BTC。

从投资者类型来看，财富管理机构及投资顾问增持 24,838 枚 BTC，占本季度机构净增持量的一半以上，持仓达到 144,307 枚 BTC，占机构披露持仓的 40.5%，连续九个季度增长。与此同时，对冲基金持仓占比已从 2024 年底的 50.6% 降至 19%。

此外，持有现货比特币 ETP 的机构管理人数量增加 191 家，达到 2,166 家。不过，报告指出，本季度增持主要由数十家大型机构推动，中小型持有者整体仍为净卖出方。

腾讯Hy4正式开源：770B模型权重开放，许可证新增商业限制

动察 Beating AI 快讯，腾讯混元正式开源 Hy4，这次同时开放了 Hy4 正式版模型、FP8 量化版和预训练底座，并提供 GGUF 压缩版本，支持开发者自行部署和微调。

不过，开源协议发生了变化。此前 Hy4 Preview 采用 Apache 2.0，正式版则改用腾讯自定义的 Tencent Hy License。普通开发者仍可免费使用、修改和商用，但经营模型 API 等 MaaS 服务的企业，如果过去连续 12 个月全球总营收超过 5000 万美元，或相关产品月活超过 1 亿，就必须另行取得腾讯书面授权。这些限制同样适用于微调、量化等衍生模型。

腾讯还同步发布了 Hy4 System Card，披露更完整的模型安全评估，包括网络安全、生物安全等方面的潜在风险。

目前，Hy4 权重已在 Hugging Face、ModelScope、GitCode 等平台开放下载。

Anthropic上市首日散户净买盘不及预期，盘中估算仅为原预期的三分之一

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，据 Vanda Research 监测，Anthropic（ANT）11 月 19 日在纳斯达克上市后，散户买卖活跃，但净买盘弱于 SpaceX 同期。ANT 开盘后 30 分钟，散户买卖合计成交约 2.55 亿美元，超过 SpaceX 上市同期的两倍，但净买入仅 1860 万美元，低于 SpaceX 同期的 2560 万美元。到上市后第三小时，ANT 散户累计净买入 3700 万美元，较 SpaceX 同期的 9900 万美元低约 63%。

Vanda 上市前曾预计，ANT 首日散户净买入约 2.5 亿美元，高于 SpaceX 首日的 1.18 亿美元。上市后，Vanda 观察到散户买盘占比在早段交易中由 57.2% 降至 52.5%，并根据盘中交易将全日净买入估算降至 8000 万至 9000 万美元，约为原预期的三分之一。

IPO 配售方面，约 1200 家机构参与申购，逾半数未获配售；散户获配约 15% 的公开发行份额，价值约 120 亿美元，低于招股书所列的 20% 上限。配售结果不能说明机构上市后买入了多少。按雅虎财经历史行情，ANT 首日全市场成交约 8.40 亿股，以 111.50 美元开盘，收报 97.17 美元，较 83 美元发行价上涨 17.07%。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Eligible Standard Chartered clients can move tokenized deposits between Singapore and Hong Kong on the bank’s network.
- A separate trial with OCBC and StraitsX completed US dollar payments between banks outside conventional cutoffs.
- Commercial use of the cross-bank setup would require participant approvals, legal documentation and operational risk assessments.
Standard Chartered said Nov. 19 that eligible clients can now transfer tokenized deposits, bank balances recorded on a digital ledger, between Singapore and Hong Kong in near real time.
That gives corporate treasury teams a way to shift cash between entities in the same group on the bank’s own blockchain.
Meanwhile, a separate trial with OCBC and StraitsX tested payments across two banks’ networks.
The bank’s Singapore expansion covers treasury and investment transactions that use commercial bank deposits. Standard Chartered listed the Singapore dollar, Hong Kong dollar, US dollar, euro, offshore Chinese yuan and British pound among the supported currencies.
It named corporate treasurers, banks, investment platforms, and digital asset businesses as potential users, but detailed eligibility criteria and operating hours for the route remain unspecified.
The bank disclosed round-the-clock settlement when it launched its Hong Kong service Nov. 2. That schedule applies to tokenized deposit transactions settled between participating banks in central bank money through the Hong Kong Monetary Authority’s EnsembleTX infrastructure.
How Standard Chartered's cross-bank test worked
On Nov. 19, Standard Chartered, Singapore bank OCBC and payment infrastructure provider StraitsX said they had completed a controlled trial under the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s BLOOM initiative.
The trial completed US dollar payments across the banks’ separate deposit networks outside conventional cutoffs. Participants said the test showed how payments could move within minutes, including compliance checks, liquidity checks, and settlement.
The trial partners, StraitsX, OCBC and Standard Chartered, explain that each tokenized deposit remains a claim on the bank that issued it. Banks can use different platforms and standards for their deposits, so interbank payments need a way to coordinate settlement across those systems.
StraitsX coordinated payment instructions and transaction details and helped with screening and settlement. The shared infrastructure handled the payment process across both networks, from initiation to confirmation.
The partners reported that this setup reduced the need for bilateral prefunding, where banks set aside money in advance to cover payments.
A commercial service based on the trial would still depend on regulatory engagement, participant approval, legal documentation, and operational risk assessments, the partners said. They also flagged settlement finality, meaning when a payment becomes irrevocable.
Banks would need to work out who is responsible for each step, how to screen for financial crime and how to keep enough funds available for payments to settle.
items.title: Standard Chartered and OCBC test dollar payments in minutes without traditional banking cutoffs

Anthropic上市被骂「定时炸弹」，美国两党提案查AI烧钱账本

动察 Beating AI 快讯，据 Semafor 报道，民主党众议员 Pramila Jayapal 直言，华尔街不该靠一家可能成为「定时炸弹」的公司赚钱。她认为，Anthropic 上市只会巩固有问题的商业模式，奖励其不顾风险的研发速度。

参议院银行委员会民主党领袖 Elizabeth Warren 则将矛头指向金融风险：Anthropic 自己都警告，先进 AI 可能给人类带来生存威胁，却没有充分说明，如果上市后出现重大问题，美国人的退休储蓄和整个金融体系会受到什么影响。

11 月 19 日，民主、共和两党四名参议员联合提出《AUDIT AI 法案》，准备加强对 AI 行业巨额投资的审查。

法案要求上市公司披露 AI 投资背后的资金来源，包括合资企业、特殊目的公司及重大债务安排。企业还需说明对外部模型和算力供应商的依赖程度，以及董事会如何监督相关风险。

此前，美国五个州的财政负责人已联名致信 Anthropic，要求公司披露：如果为了 AI 安全推迟发布新模型，会对收入、现金流、债务偿付和盈利造成多大影响。

Anthropic 的股权结构也遭到批评。七名创始人掌握 50.1% 的投票权，普通股东却缺乏足够的制衡手段。这些财政负责人还要求公司考虑为创始人的特殊投票权设置终止期限，并公开更多长期利益信托的运作细节。

民主党将在 2027 年 1 月接掌国会，AI 监管预计成为重点议题。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Institutional Bitcoin ETF holdings clock record quarter after selling streak
Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.
Institutional investment managers’ holdings of US Bitcoin exchange-traded funds climbed to a record high in the third quarter, as they reversed three straight quarters of net selling, according to regulatory filings.
The 13F filings, analyzed by Galaxy Research, show that the reporting companies added an equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin (BTC) in the third quarter, outpacing the 47,054 Bitcoin they shed over the last three quarters combined. This lifted the reported total holdings to 356,491 BTC, the highest on record.
“The quarter’s accumulation was the work of a few dozen large institutions,” wrote Galaxy’s head of firmwide research Alex Thorn.
Quarterly 13F filings provide a point-in-time snapshot of US-listed securities held by reporting institutional investment managers. Thorn said half of the net addition of spot Bitcoin ETF shares came from advisors and wealth platforms.
Wells Fargo posted the largest increase, adding the equivalent of 14,636 Bitcoin, making it the largest institutional holder of spot Bitcoin ETPs. Other strong gainers included Brevan Howard, Bank of America, Millennium Management and Jane Street.
“Early readings suggest longer-term holders make up a growing share of the spot Bitcoin ETF investor base,” Bitwise analyst Camran Khosravi previously told Cointelegraph, when the first batch of 13F filings had begun to come in.
The number of managers reporting a position in a spot Bitcoin ETF also rose for the first time in three quarters, increasing by 191 to 2,166.
This all came as Bitcoin gained about 43% in the third quarter, ending September at $83,621.
Related: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
Meanwhile, Galaxy’s data shows BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust accounted for the largest share of holdings reported by 13F filers, with the equivalent of 232,453 BTC held by the filers. This was followed by the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund.
Together, the two funds were responsible for 77% of all Bitcoin held by the reporting entities.
US Bitcoin ETFs post two months of outflows
The record institutional holdings in Q3 contrast with more recent weakness in US spot Bitcoin ETFs, with net monthly outflows reaching $515 million in October and $2.9 billion of outflows month to date, according to TFTC’s Bitcoin ETF tracker.
Earlier in the month, Bitwise head of research André Dragosch told Cointelegraph he viewed the selling as “related to a short-term risk-off environment rather than a structural change in institutional sentiment.”

五大加密平台同时段Anthropic成交额达正股4.8%，Trade.xyz再次占据链上主导地位

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，据 TradingBeats 监测，Anthropic 上市首日带动加密衍生品市场大幅放量。过去 24 小时，Binance、Hyperliquid、OKX 等 19 家加密交易平台的 Anthropic 永续合约合计成交约 73.5 亿美元。

在全网成交额中，Binance 贡献约 32.44 亿美元。正股方面，美东时间 11 月 19 日，Anthropic 在纳斯达克上市首日累计成交约 8.57 亿股、成交额 874.35 亿美元，收报 97.17 美元，较发行价上涨 17.1%。

聚焦美东 11:48 首笔成交至 16:00 收盘的四个多小时，按分钟行情计算，仅 Binance、Hyperliquid、OKX、Bitget 与 Bybit 五家平台，Anthropic 永续合约成交额即达约 41.9 亿美元，相当于同期美股正股成交额的 4.8%；其中 Hyperliquid 三份合约合计贡献约 11.4 亿美元。

Hyperliquid 站内虹吸加剧： 链上衍生品平台内部呈现高度集中态势。Anthropic 上市前，Trade.xyz 成交额便已领先 Entropy。

Serenity：光通信仍是AI产业链中最具吸引力的投资机会，行业需求与战略价值持续提升

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，Serenity 发文表示，尽管自己研究了生物科技、物理 AI、网络安全和太空等多个领域，但仍认为光通信是当前最具吸引力的投资机会。其指出，从马斯克旗下 SPCX 收购 Mesh、Marvell 收购 Lumentum，到三星电子推进光子代工、SK 海力士布局 CPO 并收购光子集成电路（PIC）相关知识产权，产业链巨头正持续加码光学技术，私募资本也在积极投资相关初创企业。

Serenity 特别提到，光通信供应链订单与产能预订正在加速：SOI 单季度签署 12 亿美元协议，而此前季度营收仅约 2500 万美元；Coherent 签署了 200 亿美元长期供货协议；Lumentum 的产能已售罄至 2029 年。

Serenity 认为，即使 AI 资本开支放缓，光学技术仍有明确的经济驱动力：CPO 可提升 GPU 能效与电力利用率，光学内存池化则有望降低部分场景对昂贵 HBM4 的需求。与此同时，光通信在 AI 集群总成本中的占比相对较低，但随着 NPO/CPO 升级，光学器件用量及单价均有望显著提升。

在投资标的方面，Serenity 认为，低端 400G/800G 光模块及组装厂商未必能充分受益于产业升级，相比之下，激光器、光纤阵列、调制器、外置激光光源（ELS）及光引擎供应商更有机会获取产业转型带来的增量价值。

其总结称，光通信行业的需求、订单可见度和战略价值仍在提升，但相关公司估值已大幅回落，认为市场可能低估了 AI 产业向光互联转型的长期机会，并表示看好整个行业向「光」转型。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378342

存储市场多空信号交织：美光警告2027年供需更紧，NAND晶圆现货价格单月下跌24%

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，今日市场显示全球存储产业链供需分化加剧。一方面，美光预计 2027 年存储芯片供需将比今年更加紧张，集邦咨询称 2027 年 HBM 采购大体已定；另一方面，512Gb TLC NAND 晶圆现货价格一个月内下跌 24%，反映手机和 PC 市场采购需求仍然偏弱。主要动态如下：

1. 供应链紧张持续：美国行业协会警告，全球 PCB 短缺危机正在蔓延，供应紧张局面可能持续至 2028 年。

2. 美光看紧 2027 年供需：美光表示，2027 年存储芯片供需形势将比今年更加紧张。

3. HBM 订单提前锁定：集邦咨询称，2027 年 HBM 采购大体已定，2028 年需求则取决于数据中心建设进度。

4. NAND 资本支出增长：集邦咨询预计，2027 年 NAND Flash 资本支出将增长 26.7%。

5. NAND 现货价格下跌：512Gb TLC NAND 晶圆现货价格一个月下跌 24%，手机和 PC 采购需求偏弱。

6. 三星调整管理层：三星电子任命新存储业务负责人，其此前曾主管 DRAM 和 HBM 研发。

7. 长鑫科技提高回购额度：将回购上限提高至 50 亿元，回购价格上限为每股 63.78 元。

8. SK 海力士推进 AI 存储技术：展示存算一体及 CXL 内存池技术，并将 SSD 与 DRAM 纳入 AI 缓存分层体系，以提高大规模推理的数据利用效率。

9. 美国 ITC 发布 DRAM 相关裁决：对动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）设备及其下游产品和组件（III）作出 337 部分终裁。

10. 香港家办解除 AI 押注：一家香港家族办公室大举解除规模达 39 亿美元的 AI 相关投资，清仓美光、西部数据等股票。

11. 铁威马推出黑五促销：促销覆盖 NAS、直连存储及便携式 SSD 产品。

Anthropic手握超2300亿美元资金，CEO却还想借钱研发AI

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 刚完成史上最大规模的 IPO。根据最终招股书，以 9 月底的财务数据为基础，计入上市募资及 260 亿美元配套私募后，公司预计拥有约 2324 亿美元现金及短期投资。

这笔巨款还远远覆盖不了 Anthropic 的算力野心。公司已签下约 9009 亿美元的长期算力及基础设施合同，其中约 707 亿美元预计在未来 12 个月内到期。

Anthropic 甚至开始提前锁定发电设备。今年 9 月，公司签下约 34 亿美元的协议，向得州供应商 OnePWR 预订总计 1.7 吉瓦的天然气发电机组，以及配套的工程建设资源，为未来的数据中心供电。

上市当天，CEO Dario Amodei 在 CNBC 采访中表示，9000 亿美元的算力承诺分散在未来多年。考虑到公司现有的现金和收入规模，实际负担没有数字看起来那么夸张。

他还希望 Anthropic 未来获得投资级信用评级，进一步通过发行债券融资。即使已经筹集超过千亿美元，公司仍准备继续借钱扩张算力。

Amodei 同日在上市致辞中重申，Anthropic 会根据安全需要放慢 AI 模型的训练和发布，无论需要多长时间，都不会向商业或政治压力妥协。

Anthropic上市未能缓解AI相关忧虑，亚洲芯片股遭遇抛售

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，尽管 Anthropic 成功上市，但亚洲芯片相关股票周五仍重现跌势。这表明，过去数月不断累积的、针对 AI 相关投资的担忧，依然主导着投资者的情绪。

在日本，芯片测试设备制造商爱德万测试股价一度大跌 12%，科技投资巨头软银集团在东京股市重挫 17%，拖累日经 225 指数跌至 4 月以来的最低水平。在韩国，SK 海力士和三星电子的跌幅均超过 6%。即便是在中国台湾——当地为稳定股市已收紧了卖空限制——相关股票也遭到抛售，台积电和联发科股价均出现下滑。AI 行业近期频频出现令其长期前景蒙上阴影的动态。

美国中期选举后的监管风险，以及英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋突然离职的消息，加剧了市场对于企业巨额支出及其变现前景的担忧。盛宝金融首席投资策略师 Charu Chanana 表示：「AI 相关投资此前就已面临诸多质疑，例如基础设施支出是否过度、是否存在循环融资，以及投资回报能否覆盖投入成本。

Anthropic 的成功上市并未解答这些疑问。相反，它吸引了更多资本涌入前沿 AI 模型领域——而这一领域竞争异常激烈，定价权正在减弱，盈利能力也依然充满不确定性。」

items.author: craigkerstiens
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[jzelinskie]: I haven't used these extensions, but I like the direction of being able to extend Postgres by tailing its own internals (pg_squeeze approach) than triggers (pg_repack). We (the SpiceDB developers) took a similar approach to solve a different problem a few years ago: implementing strict serializability in Postgres[0]. By hooking into the transactions layer themselves (pg_xact), we could layer on our own MVCC reusing the real Postgres transactions to compute visibility and total ordering. ...

[nopurpose]: They added plan hinting, but sadly not via comments. To use hinting an app needs to issue a `SET` command, which adds round trip latency for each query. Need to use quite unergonomic query batching/pipelining to negate that latency.

[inkysigma]: Isn't losing MVCC consistency a pretty big drawback? Am I misinterpreting or does that mean occasionally a query might just return nothing for possibly difficult to diagnose reasons?

[aurareturn]: Trying to recoup space at a slow period, I remember using Repack on New Years Eve on my local computer for a multi TB production DB and waiting hours and hours hoping my connection doesn’t drop. When it dropped, I had to restart all over again. I thought it would be a simple process but it ended up taking many hours and a few retries. Holy hell it was a miserable experience and it ruined my New Years Eve. I’m so happy this is now built in.

[dap]: Having worked on clusters where bloat was an ongoing serious problem, this looks really useful!  Thanks for doing this work.
items.title: Postgres 19 Repack: Faster, Built-In Table Bloat Cleanup

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Students scored higher on proctored exams after instructors introduced AI tools tailored to applied STEM courses.
- The trial enrolled 7,200 students across 19 universities, with 4,768 students in the experimental exam analysis.
- The trial compared earlier and later rollouts, leaving open how course-specific tools would perform against generic chatbots.
Students in applied STEM courses scored higher on proctored exams when instructors introduced AI tools tailored to their classes, compared with classes still waiting for their tools, according to a randomized trial across 19 universities reported in a Nov. 14 preprint.
The research led by Jun Li of the University of Michigan estimated a student-level gain of 0.32 standard deviations, with a 95% confidence interval of 0.06 to 0.59 standard deviations.
The estimate puts the improvement at roughly 33% of the typical spread in scores within a class and leaves uncertainty about the size of the gain. Standardizing scores within each class gave researchers a common scale for comparing results across courses that used different exams.
The preregistered trial involved 7,200 students in 55 applied STEM classes over three semesters, from spring 2025 through spring 2026. The study counted each course-and-instructor pairing as one class.
The experimental part of the exam analysis covered 4,768 students across 44 course offerings. Researchers used results from earlier terms alongside that sample to account for how classes had performed before the rollout.
The exam analysis included only proctored, in-person exams, mostly on paper. The remaining exams used strictly monitored computers or restricted-access computers at university testing centers.
The researchers added that screening rule after preregistration and excluded course offerings where exams could allow AI assistance.
What instructors built with AI tools
Researchers grouped classes by subject and academic level, then randomly assigned them to introduce their tools immediately or one teaching term later.
Instructors in both groups received design and technical support, including training sessions, examples of how to write instructions for the tools, and access to a platform to build and deploy them.
Once instructors brought the tools into their courses, all students in those classes had access during the term, before sitting the exams used to measure learning.
Some instructors built tutors that gave students targeted practice and feedback, while others built coaches that guided students through problems by asking questions. Instructors also designed interactive simulations and ran role-play exercises that let students question AI-generated stakeholders.
The study detected no statistically significant change in engagement or satisfaction. Engagement measures varied by class and included records such as attendance and assignment completion, and satisfaction came from end-of-term course evaluations.
The trial compared rollout timing, leaving open how course-specific tools would fare against generic chatbots. How much each design contributed to the gain and whether it extends beyond applied STEM remain open questions.

Michael Saylor：Strategy采取择机操作策略，目前首要任务是支持数字信贷业务

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，Strategy 创始人 Michael Saylor 在接受采访时表示，「在任何一天，Strategy 都会综合考虑多方面因素，包括资本市场情绪、比特币的交易情况、信贷市场情绪，以及股票资本市场的溢价是在扩大还是收窄。通常来说，如果看最常见的资产置换交易，Strategy 会进行几种操作：用 MSTR 置换 BTC、用 MSTR 置换 STRC，或者用 MSTR 置换美元。

我认为，Strategy 采取的是择机操作的策略。如果能够通过资产置换简单地获得比特币溢价，那么 Strategy 随时都可以这么做。不过，公司的战略核心在于财库业务，而财库业务本质上是一种信贷业务。因此，Strategy 目前的首要任务是支持数字信贷业务，并增强 STRC 的市场表现。当 STRC 表现强劲、运行良好时，实际上也会对 SR 产生支撑作用。STRC 的强势表现还会带动其他公开交易的信贷工具。

因此，我们在做决策时，也是在考虑公司的长期声誉和未来发展。有时，一项决策可能无法在本周带来可观利润，但从未来 1 至 7 年的时间跨度来看，最终可能证明其价值。」

--- Top Comments ---

[WalterBright]: > Calling EVP_EncodeBlock() with an input length close to INT_MAX may overflow the calculation of the encoded output size and write past the end of the caller-supplied output buffer. Haven't we suffered enough yet with lack of a basic feature in C? Why are enhancements going into C that never address this fundamental problem? I wrote this proposal for C 17 years ago: file:///C:/digitalmars/articles/C-biggest-mistake.html It's a simple addition, it br...

[amluto]: On a very very quick read, the bug is that EVP_EncodeBlock malfunctions if the input is larger than ~1.5GB.  EVP_EncodeBlock is a function that encodes base64.  https://docs.openssl.org/1.0.2/man3/EVP_EncodeInit/  As a seasoned C programmer, I can immediately observe that the whole API is bad: the caller is expected to calculate the buffer length on their own, using a nontrivial formula, and the caller does not pass in the output buffer length, so the implementat...

[userbinator]: I think CVSS 9.8 is exaggerated. This is not remotely anywhere near as serious as Heartbleed. It's an internal function which will fail if its input is far too long, but exploitability rests on how untrusted input can reach it; the key word being "untrusted". E.g. if you operate a base64 encoding service on the Internet that just reads all the data into memory at once and calls EVP_EncodeBlock(), that's exploitable. If you have a protocol that involves a block of data with...

[ansipunk]: I am not a system administrator, but I am getting a serious vulnerability fatigue, every single day there's at least two new vulnerabilities in major pieces of software, I'm just tired of seeing that everywhere and hearing that everywhere. Fellow system administrators must be having it much worse.

[Panzerschrek]: That's why it's recommended to use  size_t  for passing sizes of buffers. It's unlikely to get overflow with it. In this particular case input buffer needs to have size larger than half of address space in order to trigger overflow, which isn't possible (64-bit systems usually have only 48 bits of actual address space, 32-bit systems don't allow allocating so large blocks).

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，Anthropic IPO 打新配售结果陆续公布，多家加密交易平台披露了实际获配情况，平台之间的配售规模差异明显。Bitget 最终获配 153,774 股 Anthropic 代币化股票，按 83 美元发行价计算，总价值约 1276 万美元。总申购额约 2.17 亿美元，13,290 人参与。其中 VIP 轮获配 137,494 股，配售率 10.06%；公开轮获配 16,280 股，配售率仅 1.3%。

Gate 最终获配 92,100 股 ANT，总价值约 764.43 万 USDT。总申购额约 1.52 亿 USDT，整体配售率约 5.03%。

相比之下，Binance 钱包最终仅获配约 2957 份 Anthropic 代币化股票，按 83 美元发行价计算，价值约 24.54 万美元。由于实际获配额度低于预期，Binance 钱包决定退还用户全部申购本金，并将已获配份额免费按比例空投，同时额外发放价值 100 万美元的 ANTB 代币奖励，符合条件的参与者至少可获得约 6 USDC 等值代币。

Binance US Moves Closer to U.S. Perpetual Futures as CFTC Clears DCM and DCO Applications for Substantive Review

Binance US said the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has deemed its applications to register as a designated contract market (DCM) and derivatives clearing organization (DCO) substantially complete, moving them into substantive review. Neither application has been approved. DCM registration would allow Binance US to offer derivatives trading, including futures and options, while DCO registration would allow it to clear those trades. Binance US plans to use both registrations to offer U.S. users regulated derivatives, including perpetual futures. It has not launched any derivatives products and must await formal CFTC approval before doing so.

According to the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) website, BAM Derivatives LLC submitted Binance US’s application to register as a designated contract market (DCM). The filing appeared in the public record on November 19 and is currently listed as “pending.” BAM Derivatives plans to list Bitcoin and Ether perpetual contracts, with BAM Clearing LLC providing clearing services. — link
items.title: Binance US Moves Closer to U.S. Perpetual Futures as CFTC Clears DCM and DCO App

CFTC Chair: Onchain Platforms Like Hyperliquid Must Register or Partner With Licensed Exchanges to Enter US Market, Citing Backpack Model

CFTC Chair Michael Selig said onchain platforms such as Hyperliquid must register as exchanges or partner with registered exchanges to offer derivatives to U.S. retail users. They must follow the same rules as traditional exchanges but may still use onchain technology. He cited Backpack, which recently secured futures commission merchant (FCM), designated contract market (DCM) and derivatives clearing organization (DCO) approvals as a compliance basis for entering the U.S. market.

On prediction markets, Selig said the CFTC would work with the Justice Department to defend its federal authority over lawful derivatives contracts against state lawsuits. He also said a single-stock perpetual contract is not necessarily a security-based swap simply because it has no expiry date: its classification depends on its structure, and perpetual funding rates resemble the variation margin settlement used in traditional futures. — link

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Ledger is offering limited-time X-ray inspections for suspect hardware wallets at its factory in Vierzon, France.
- Ledger urges concerned buyers who purchased in Berlin from January 2026 onward to contact support as it investigates reports involving two Dubai devices.
- Ledger advises anyone who already used a suspect device to move funds to a wallet with a fresh recovery phrase.
Ledger is offering limited-time X-ray inspections for suspect hardware wallets as its tampering investigation reaches Berlin.
In a Nov. 18 update, the wallet maker said its support team can arrange for customers to send a device to its factory in Vierzon, France, for inspection and return.
The offer lets owners have their device examined for physical alterations. For anyone who has already used a suspect device, Ledger advised moving funds to a wallet with a fresh recovery phrase. The company also said in its advisory that the hardware it found was designed to capture those words during setup.
Ledger noted that the German cases it had investigated were localized to Berlin. The company advised concerned customers who bought a Ledger wallet from a third party there from January 2026 onward to contact its support team.
It also asks concerned buyers who purchased from third parties in Southeast Asia or Dubai to get in touch.
Ledger revealed it is still investigating reports involving two devices in Dubai and is working with distribution partners to learn how they entered circulation. It reported one affected Nano Gen 5 as it continues its investigation into Southeast Asian resellers.
The advisory described the inspection as an option for devices that raise concerns, so customers can ask Ledger Support to arrange secure shipment through an official ticket.
Ledger recommended sending a device only through that channel, and that support will never ask for a recovery phrase. Its guidance for buyers in Berlin, Dubai, and Southeast Asia describes when to contact Ledger, while support handles the arrangements for individual devices sent to the factory.
The inspection can look inside the submitted device for added hardware, since Ledger’s Genuine Check verifies the secure chip's authenticity. Where that chip remains intact, the check can miss a physical addition.
Ledger reported that all the devices it confirmed in this incident carried the same physical modification and that the investigation found no flaw in its secure chip or operating system.
In its Oct. 15 disclosure, Ledger said genuine wallets had been altered after leaving its control and distributed through Southeast Asian resellers.
The company said the samples it examined from stores, warehouses, and its own stock at the time were clean. In November, it described the Berlin findings as part of the same incident and that it still had no confirmed case involving a device bought directly from ledger.com.
When a recovery phrase may be exposed
Ledger advised owners of an unused suspect device to leave it unopened, keep it out of use, and contact official support. They should avoid using it to set up a new wallet or restore an existing one.
For owners who have already used a suspect device, Ledger advised moving funds to a new wallet with a fresh recovery phrase, generated on a device bought directly from its website. It also recommended avoiding reusing any passphrase used on the suspect device.
The recovery phrase is the set of words that lets an owner restore access to a wallet on a compatible device. Entering the same words on replacement hardware brings up the same wallet and leaves the original recovery credential in use.
Someone who already obtained the credentials needed to restore that wallet could use a compatible device of their own. Moving funds to a wallet with a fresh phrase changes the credentials that control those funds.
Meanwhile, an X-ray can look for evidence of physical tampering. Finding an implant would show the unit was altered.
Whether anyone already obtained a particular owner’s recovery words is a separate question that the scan alone cannot answer.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.
Ledger chief technology officer Charles Guillemet announced he will be leaving the company at the end of 2026, after nine years at the company.
In a post on LinkedIn on Thursday, Guillemet said he joined as chief security officer in December 2017, around three years after Ledger was founded. He launched Ledger Donjon, the company’s attack lab, a year later.
“We’ve been preparing this transition for many months, so Ledger’s teams, partners and roadmaps are ready. I’m bullish on Ledger’s future,” said Guillemet.
Guillemet has been a central figure in Ledger’s security operations, first as chief security officer and later as chief technology officer. He helped establish the Ledger Donjon attack lab, which tests hardware and software vulnerabilities. According to Guillemet, Ledger devices now secure roughly 20% of the world’s crypto assets.
“The threat landscape changed too. AI is making attacks cheaper, faster and easier to scale,” he added.
“The question we spent a decade answering for crypto (how do you protect what matters when any device can be compromised?) is now a question for every company, every AI agent and every government.”
Guillemet did not disclose details of his next venture but said he was “building something new” and would “dedicate my time to solving this security mess.”
Guillemet’s announcement comes weeks after Ledger disclosed that attackers had modified genuine hardware wallets with hidden components designed to capture users’ recovery phrases, and slipped the devices into authorized resellers.
The tampering cases were initially reported in Asia, with subsequent incidents identified in Europe and the United Arab Emirates.
Related: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
items.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company

Anthropic创纪录IPO推动美国全年融资规模创新高

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，Anthropic 上市进一步推高了今年美国 IPO 市场的融资规模。彭博汇编数据显示，截至周三，计入 Anthropic 此次上市后，2026 年美国 IPO 募资总额接近 2460 亿美元，超过 2021 年创下的 1950 亿美元纪录。该统计不包括空白支票公司等金融工具。

今年的融资规模很大程度上受到 SpaceX 上市推动。SpaceX 在 IPO 推介过程中，将 AI 领域的市场机会作为重要卖点之一。此外，韩国存储芯片制造商 SK 海力士发行了 265 亿美元美国存托凭证（ADR），也进一步扩大了融资总额。

Anthropic 的上市还将带来后续股票供应。根据公司提交的文件，除 IPO 发行的 9.8 亿股外，上市首日非创始员工、董事会成员以及前员工最多还可以出售 3.15 亿股，其中包括首席财务官克里希纳·拉奥（Krishna Rao）持有的股份。内部人士持有的约 155 亿股股票则受到限售协议约束，相关限制将持续至公司明年第三季度公布业绩之后。

与此同时，Anthropic 还可能受益于指数基金带来的被动买入需求。如果符合提前纳入指数的条件，公司最快可能于今年 12 月进入罗素 1000 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数。

items.content:
Anthropic超级IPO之后，人才留存迎来考验

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，今天对 Anthropic 而言是一座重要里程碑。这家成立五年、开发 Claude 大模型的企业，抢在劲敌 OpenAI 之前登陆公开市场；公司于今日晚些时候开盘交易后，大量员工将跻身百万富翁，甚至亿万富翁之列。

而核心问题在于：上市这一天，对 Anthropic 的未来意味着什么？假设股价不崩盘，这笔突如其来的财富，可以帮助 Anthropic 员工购置房产，也能拿出一大笔新财富捐赠给各类公益项目，比如虾类福利保护。但反直觉的一点是：这笔财富，也可能让他们离开这家给自己带来财富的公司。

这些员工还有另一个去向：跳槽到其他 AI 实验室。有多起从业者从一家 AI 公司跳槽至另一家的案例，目的是分散自己手中 AI 企业股权的持仓。这样一来，就算最后赢得 AI 竞赛的不是 Anthropic 而是 OpenAI，他们依然能够收益。如果大量研究员流失，对 Anthropic 绝非好事。这家公司之所以能走到今天，低人才流失率是关键原因之一。能否留住员工，是 Anthropic 上市之后投资者重点观察的一大问题。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Sygnum expects crypto carry trades that buy spot and short futures to earn more than Treasury bills on average in 2027.
- The bank cited 67 consecutive days of negative Bitcoin funding in 2026 and expects demand for leverage to return.
- If about $360 billion rotates from Nasdaq stocks into crypto, Sygnum sees crypto market value rising over 60% and Bitcoin nearing $128,000.
Sygnum expects crypto carry trades to earn more than Treasury bills on average in 2027, according to its annual Sygnal outlook released Nov. 19.
The bank also pointed to a recovery in Bitcoin funding rates and futures premiums, citing 67 consecutive days of negative Bitcoin funding in 2026.
The bank expects renewed demand for leverage to keep funding rates and futures basis mostly positive in 2027, even after the Federal Reserve raised its policy-rate target range to 3.75%-4% in September.
How Bitcoin carry earns a spread
The trade pairs a Bitcoin purchase with a short futures position. If the two positions are sized to offset each other, a rise in Bitcoin helps the purchase and hurts the short. The trader seeks to earn a premium on dated futures or collect funding payments on perpetual futures.
With a dated futures contract, the gap between the futures price and the spot price is called the basis. When the contract trades above spot, the trader can buy Bitcoin at the lower price and sell futures at the higher price, and the two prices converge at expiry.
Perpetual futures have no expiry, so their funding payments recur while positions are open. When funding is positive, longs pay shorts, and shorts pay longs when it is negative. The 67-day streak Sygnum cites describes how long funding stayed negative, when traders shorting perpetuals would have faced a funding cost.
The Treasury-bill comparison asks what the same capital could earn in short-term US government debt. The Fed’s policy rate sets the context for short-term rates.
In Sygnal Six, the bank estimates that if about $360 billion, or 0.75% of Nasdaq market value, moved into crypto, total crypto market capitalization could rise more than 60% and Bitcoin could reach a new high near $128,000.
Those two forecasts sit alongside six others on token value accrual, Bitcoin in strategic reserves, stablecoins in correspondent banking, tokenization, prediction markets and AI demand.
Fabian Dori, the bank’s chief investment officer and the report’s lead author, said investors should look beyond price to fundamentals.
Mostly positive funding rates and futures premiums in 2027 would support Sygnum’s case for a carry recovery. The test is whether the resulting average return clears Treasury bills.

特朗普：不会在新年前「仓促」决定对伊朗行动

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，据央视新闻报道，美国总统特朗普 19 日表示，在新年到来之前，他不会就伊朗问题的下一步行动「仓促」作出决定。特朗普当天接受采访时说，他不会就伊朗问题「仓促」作出任何决定，「我们要看看新年之后局势如何发展」。

据美方相关分析称，特朗普所提及的时间节点可能意味着，他希望为美国对伊朗实施的海上封锁和经济施压行动留出更多时间以发挥作用。这也可能表明，如果伊朗今年年底前不让步，特朗普希望在由民主党掌控的新一届国会正式履职前，为自己留出足够的时间来采取军事行动。

分析还表示，特朗普当前面临来自以色列看守政府总理内塔尼亚胡的巨大压力，后者敦促他尽快对伊朗发动一场决定性的轰炸行动。据知情人士透露，白宫已要求五角大楼和情报专家评估伊朗将如何应对美军制定的各项打击方案。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 20 日，据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic(ANT.O) 上市后的市值计算出现巨大差异，关键在于是否把未来可能新增的股份也算进去。

按照首日开盘价 111.50 美元计算，如果只统计目前已经发行的股份，公司市值略低于 1.5 万亿美元；如果把未来可能通过员工股票奖励、股票期权、亚马逊 (AMZN.O) 可转换债券等方式增加的股份全部计入，市值将超过 2 万亿美元，两种算法相差逾 5000 亿美元。其中，员工慈善捐赠配套计划可能导致 Anthropic 未来最多额外发行约 5.53 亿股，按开盘价计算价值约 620 亿美元。

此外，亚马逊持有的部分可转换债券未来也可能转为股份，公司董事会还可在股价达到特定目标后，向公共利益基金额外发行相当于公司股份 2% 的股票。报道指出，如果只按照目前已发行的股份计算，可能低估公司的实际估值。

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Citi’s November agreement treats activity by third-party AI agents as customer-authorized, even if credentials are leaked or an agent ignores instructions.
- PNC updated its rules Wednesday, while Citizens warned customers about AI-agent activity; JPMorgan and Bank of America had already tightened policies.
- Federal rules still restrict when banks can hold consumers liable for genuinely unauthorized electronic transfers, regardless of contractual wording.
Citi has updated its online banking terms to make customers responsible for the actions of third-party AI agents accessing their accounts, including when an agent leaks their credentials and someone else uses them to get in.
The change, reported by TechCrunch Wednesday, makes explicit how the bank intends to handle an increasingly awkward question: Who pays when software handling your money makes a mistake?
Under Citi’s new terms, actions taken using credentials supplied to an outside agent are treated as authorized by the customer, even if the tool ignores instructions, exceeds its permissions, or shares those credentials with another party.
Citi says it has no obligation to investigate whether the agent followed the customer's original prompts, subject to applicable law.
A Citi spokesperson told TechCrunch that the November revision clarifies the risks of sharing banking credentials or granting outside tools account access. The provision does not apply to AI agents offered by Citi itself.
Banks tighten the rules on AI access
Citi is not acting alone. JPMorgan and Bank of America announced similar policies in October, while Citizens Bank warned customers this week by email that they could be responsible for what their AI assistants do.
PNC also changed its digital agreement on Wednesday. Its rules distinguish bank-approved connections, which can provide limited access, from handing an agent unrestricted access to an account.
The move follows a banking security scare from October 22. Major banks had detected AI agents logging into customer accounts, sometimes taking steps that appeared to go beyond their users' instructions, and executives said they struggled to determine which agents had been properly authorized.
An AI agent differs from a conventional chatbot because it can act on a user's behalf, potentially navigating websites, accessing financial records, or initiating payments. That makes a mistaken instruction or compromised login more consequential than a bad answer about a bank balance.
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has since issued AI examiner guidance that addresses outside agents, payment controls, and human approval. The framework is nonbinding and does not itself create new requirements for banks.
A banking agreement cannot erase federal protections
Citi's language does not automatically eliminate consumer fraud protections. Under U.S. federal consumer protection rules, banks generally must investigate unauthorized electronic transfers and limit customers' financial liability for fraud. Those protections cannot simply be waived through a banking agreement, although their application to transactions performed by customer-authorized AI agents remains less clear.
The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau says banks cannot use agreements to waive those legal protections, although the rules distinguish theft by an outsider from transfers actually authorized by a customer or someone given access.
Whether a particular AI-related loss qualifies as unauthorized depends on how the transaction occurred.
PNC's updated agreement takes a stricter operational approach: Customers may use certain connection methods approved by the bank, but cannot give third-party AI agents their passwords or one-time security codes, and agents generally cannot initiate payments unless PNC expressly permits it.

Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.
Binance obtains $6.5B global freeze order, plans to expand throughout Asia
Binance has secured a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing injunction from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts as it seeks to recover assets stolen in its record Oct. 29 hack.
The court orders target unidentified perpetrators of the attack and are intended to help issuers, exchanges and other partners freeze and return stolen assets,
The orders can be served via blockchain, allowing legal notices to be delivered to wallet addresses rather than through traditional channels. Market participants will also be notified of updates to a “living list” of 26,000 wallet addresses identified as holding stolen assets.
Despite losing billions in the hack, Binance’s APAC head SB Seker told Reuters this week its finances are sound and it plans to expand throughout South East Asia.
“We have ongoing conversations with at least five or six markets ... three of which are in quite mature stages,” he said. Binance currently has operating licenses in 15 markets.
Source: Binance
HONG KONG
Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) added decentralized perps exchange Hyperliquid to its Alert List. The SFC said Hyperliquid lacks a license to operate in the city and is suspected of actively marketing its services to the region’s public.
The SFC is now officially suspicious of 69 platforms.
More Hong Kong news
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Swift will explore linking the HKMA’s market infrastructure, Project Ensemble, with Swift’s ledger, for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.
SINGAPORE
Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) issued 100 million Singapore dollars ($77.5 million) in tokenized bills on Nov. 6, with banks using wholesale central bank digital currency (CBDC) to pay for them. Five banks submitted bids totaling more than twice the amount on offer, MAS said Thursday. The four-week bills mature on Dec. 4.
MAS issued the bills directly on the Singapore Dollar Test Network. That gives borrowers an asset they could pledge as collateral for loans on the network, the central bank said.
Source: Pexels
More Singapore news
Singapore’s DBS has partnered with Circle to broaden customer access to USDC across Asia.
CryptoJobsList has acquired its rival crypto jobs service Crypto.jobs.
Wisdom Tree has registered three tokenized funds in Singapore and is working with Synthesys to make them available through regulated intermediaries.
Citadel Securities is expanding its Singapore and Sydney offices by 40% and 65% respectively.
CHINA
Shanghai says yes to blockchain but CAC says no to ICO and exchange names
The Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission and the Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Data have issued a new policy that encourages the adoption of blockchain and other technologies as a way to share and track scientific data.
Meanwhile the Cyberspace Administration of China has clarified the names of blockchain information services are not allowed to include words like “virtual currency”, “exchange” and “ICO”
VIETNAM
Bunge and CP Group expand blockchain soy traceability to Vietnam
Agribusiness solutions company Bunge and feed ingredient trading firm Bangkok Produce Merchandising Company have expanded their blockchain based soy traceability initiative to Vietnam. The collaboration has already established traceable soybean and soybean meal supply chains from Brazil to Thailand.
THAILAND
Thai police arrest Pattaya crypto investment-scam suspects
Thai police have arrested four foreign nationals in Pattaya over an alleged scam that defrauded victims of more than 400 million baht ($11.8M) through fake crypto investments.
The operation followed the rescue of a 19-year-old Chinese student held for ransom three days earlier and uncovered a crypto romance scam allegedly run by three Chinese nationals and one Taiwanese fugitive.

Quick Take
- California sued OpenAI over more than 80 alleged AI security incidents, accusing the company of ignoring warnings and inadequate safeguards.
- Prosecutors allege OpenAI prioritized profits and rapid development over safety as experimental agents accessed external systems.
- The state seeks court-ordered changes to OpenAI's internal testing, while the company argues it is being unfairly singled out.
California is seeking court-ordered safeguards for OpenAI's internal AI testing after alleging at least 80 security incidents involving experimental agents.
Attorney General Rob Bonta filed the lawsuit on Nov. 16, accusing the ChatGPT developer of endangering the public by testing advanced artificial intelligence models without adequate security controls.
The complaint centers on a July incident in which hundreds of experimental OpenAI agents escaped their testing environment and compromised systems belonging to Hugging Face, an AI model hosting platform.
The attack lasted about two and a half days and was part of a broader pattern of incidents involving unauthorized access to external networks, government databases, and OpenAI's own infrastructure.
Bonta said:
“OpenAI's actions escalated real-word cybersecurity risks, threatening the safety, health, and well-being of society.”
The lawsuit names OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC as defendants and alleges violations of California's Unfair Competition Law and public nuisance provisions.
OpenAI has pushed back against the lawsuit, arguing that California is singling it out over a challenge confronting the broader AI industry.
An OpenAI spokesperson reportedly said the company published technical reports, notified affected organizations, and strengthened safeguards after the Hugging Face incident. He added that the company remained committed to working with regulators on AI safety standards.
California alleges OpenAI ignored repeated security warnings
In its complaint, California accused OpenAI of prioritizing rapid model development over safety despite knowing its experimental systems could bypass restrictions and access external networks.
The filing alleges that OpenAI “misled and endangered the public and users of its services” by developing advanced AI systems without sufficient safeguards.
According to prosecutors, the company repeatedly assured customers that its research environments could contain potentially dangerous AI behavior but continued experimenting after discovering weaknesses in those protections.
Between March and June, OpenAI identified at least five instances of experimental models taking unauthorized actions.
By May 26, some agents had exploited a software vulnerability to access the public internet. An internal monitoring system subsequently flagged malicious activity on June 27, while other incidents exposed weaknesses in the infrastructure used to isolate experimental models.
California alleged that the company continued its research without adequately addressing those warnings.
The complaint also described incidents involving software repositories, public information websites and foreign government databases containing sensitive health information.
The state said OpenAI had acknowledged losing control of its agents more than 80 times during testing but publicly disclosed only 27 incidents.
Prosecutors further accused the company of obstructing their investigation by withholding detailed information about the full extent of the incidents.
California also linked the alleged security failures to OpenAI's growing focus on revenue and rapid product development. The complaint contrasted the company's original nonprofit mission with its 2025 restructuring into a public benefit corporation, which coincided with $40 billion in funding from SoftBank.
Prosecutors noted that business customers accounted for about 40% of OpenAI's revenue in early 2026, driving its expansion into programming and cybersecurity tools.
The state further alleged that OpenAI sought to commercialize its security failures by marketing products designed to defend against threats resembling those created by its own experimental models.
California seeks judicial oversight of OpenAI's internal testing
California wants a San Francisco Superior Court judge to compel OpenAI to address unsafe conditions in its model development, training and evaluation operations.
The requested intervention would extend to internal research involving unreleased models, potentially requiring changes to how the company isolates experimental agents, monitors their behavior, and controls their access to external networks.
The complaint identifies inadequate monitoring, weakened model safeguards, and failures to contain agents within secure testing environments among the practices it seeks to address.
California also seeks an injunction preventing OpenAI from engaging in practices found to constitute unfair competition.
Beyond operational changes, the state is requesting $2,500 in civil penalties against each defendant for every proven violation of the Unfair Competition Law.
It also wants restitution for affected parties and the surrender of gains tied to unlawful conduct, with the amounts to be determined in court.
items.title: California says OpenAI lost control of AI agents 80 times while chasing profits

In brief
- Anthropic opened at $111.50 but retreated to $97.17 by market close, still 17% above its IPO price.
- Nvidia's post-earnings slump and an AMD short-seller report weighed on chipmakers, while Microsoft, Oracle and other AI-related stocks fell.
- Nvidia, Google, AMD and other AI giants have agreed to buy $26 billion in Anthropic shares through a separate, conditional private placement.
Anthropic made stock market history Thursday, raising $81.34 billion in the largest initial IPO share sale ever. But Wall Street's response was considerably less enthusiastic than the demand for the Claude developer's shares.
The stock opened at $111.50 on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, a 34% premium over its $83 offering price, briefly pushing the company's fully diluted valuation past $2 trillion.
The rally faded quickly, however, with shares dropping toward $93 before closing today at $97.17.
Did you know?
You can now act on the news you read: Go long or short Anthropic with perpetual futures, all from your Decrypt Money Account.
The offering involved 980 million shares and surpassed SpaceX's original $75 billion IPO in June. As Decrypt previously reported, SpaceX's expanded final offering reached $86.25 billion, meaning Anthropic has not surpassed that completed deal.
Investors initially welcomed the listing, sending technology stocks higher before the opening bell. By the afternoon, however, the Nasdaq Composite was down 2.06%, the S&P 500 had fallen 1.9%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average was off 2.17%.
AI stocks fall despite Anthropic's strong debut
The selloff extended across the AI supply chain. A Thursday afternoon market heatmap showed Nvidia falling 3.4%, Broadcom losing 2.07%, and memory chipmaker Micron slipping 2.17%. Microsoft was down 1.97%, while cloud infrastructure and software provider Oracle declined 2.97%.
AMD was among the hardest hit, down 7.73% in the day, although its decline had a separate catalyst. Reuters reported that the chipmaker came under pressure after investigative outlet Hunterbrook disclosed that its affiliated investment fund had taken a short position in the company.
The picture was not uniformly negative. Palo Alto Networks rose 6%, CrowdStrike gained 2.24%, and Intel added 2.25% in the same snapshot. The divergence shows that investors were distinguishing between companies rather than selling every technology stock indiscriminately.
The broader weakness comes as investors question the cost of building AI infrastructure and the returns companies can generate from that spending. Nvidia's latest earnings beat expectations, but uncertainty following Jensen Huang's resignation has continued to weigh on the semiconductor giant.
Anthropic also faces an expensive expansion. Its IPO disclosures detailed approximately $900.9 billion in infrastructure and computing commitments extending through 2045, alongside another $150 billion to $175 billion in estimated payments under less precisely defined arrangements.
"Anthropic's record-breaking IPO has failed to rekindle enthusiasm for tech stocks," Joe Maher, market economist at Capital Economics, told Reuters.
Nvidia and AI infrastructure stocks face a reality check
Nvidia's weakness was notable given its latest results. The chipmaker reported $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue on Tuesday, up 103% from a year earlier, and forecast stronger-than-expected sales for the following quarter.
Even those numbers failed to erase concerns over the departure of longtime CEO Jensen Huang after allegations of extramarital affairs and possible leaks of corporate secrets and the sustainability of the AI spending boom.
The pressure also reached companies that rent out computing capacity. Neocloud operators CoreWeave and Nebius fell 5.0% and 7.8%, respectively. Software companies were weak as well: Salesforce declined 3.17% and Adobe lost 2.03% in the afternoon heatmap. From chips and data centers to enterprise software, the losses extended beyond any single corner of the AI trade.
Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows how closely these companies are tied together. Nvidia and Google each committed roughly $10 billion to a conditional private share placement alongside the IPO.
AMD agreed to invest $2.5 billion; Broadcom, Micron and Microsoft committed $1 billion apiece; and TSMC pledged $500 million. The $26 billion placement is separate from the public offering. Several of these investors are also key suppliers or infrastructure partners in the AI ecosystem.
That creates a central question for investors: How much of the money flowing into AI companies will ultimately translate into profitable demand for chips, cloud capacity and software?
Anthropic's blockbuster debut demonstrates demand for its shares, but Thursday's broader decline shows that Wall Street is not ready to extend that confidence to every company financing or supplying the AI boom.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
items.content:
MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.
Crypto payments firm MoonPay has applied for a US national trust bank charter to offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody services.
According to an OCC filing, MoonPay submitted its application on Tuesday to establish MoonPay National Trust Bank, a non-depository institution headquartered in Miami Beach, Florida. The proposed bank would not accept traditional deposits or issue loans.
MoonPay already provides stablecoin issuance infrastructure to businesses, including support for branded digital dollars. If approved, the charter would allow its proposed banking subsidiary to provide stablecoin and custody services under federal supervision.
The application comes as US regulators prepare to implement the GENIUS Act, which takes effect on Jan. 18, 2027, and establishes federal standards for stablecoin issuers, including reserve backing and redemption requirements.
With the filing, MoonPay joins several crypto and payments companies seeking federal trust bank charters, including Rain, Modern Treasury and Block. Coinbase’s charter took effect earlier this month, while Circle received final OCC approval in July.
The rise in crypto firms applying for federal trust bank charters has drawn opposition from community banks. In October, the Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC, arguing that the regulator exceeded its authority by allowing non-depository trust banks to conduct activities traditionally associated with commercial banks.

items.author: Jake Harrison
items.content:
Skyrocketing borrow rates are proving an insufficient incentive to free up liquidity in DeFi giant Sky’s stUSDS market, with founder Rune Christensen reportedly making up approximately half of the borrowed funds.
The market, on which liquidations are paused, has been at full utilisation for several days, leaving USDS depositors unable to withdraw their funds.
Consequently, the cost of borrowing USDS via stUSDS has spiked to 25% APY, up from just 5% last month, and may hit 50% within days.
Without the threat of liquidation, the borrowers needn’t fear, unless Sky’s DAO governance steps in which, given who a large portion of the loans belong to, seems unlikely.
That said, the SKY token, collateral against which stUSDS deposits are borrowed, is down over 20% in the past 24 hours, possibly anticipating sales to free up funds for repayment.
Christensen calls the worries about Sky “overblown” and stresses the protocol is strong. He does however recognize there are “questions about stUSDS” and that they will be addressed soon.
Read more: Wallet tied to Sky founder borrowed $1M days before his company collapsed
DeFi insiders aren’t worried about the health of the wider protocol, though.
Former Maker DAO delegate “PaperImperium” estimates that, even at max (50%) borrowing cost, “it would take several years to be in danger” and that only stUSDS holders would suffer a loss.
Similarly, former Aave delegate Marc Zeller says there’s “nothing wrong” and that the stUSDS product is Christensen’s “private credit line to fund his pet projects segregated from the main saving yield.”
While there may be limited contagion risk, with little incentive to repay, it doesn’t look like significant repayments are imminent.
Even when a small amount is repaid, the slack is picked up by MEV bots, maxing utilization once more.
Read more: Aave snubs Sky’s USDS as collateral and 3 ‘underperforming’ chains
Exit strategy
The stUSDS/USDS pool on decentralized exchange Curve Finance, which was set up a year ago to provide “supporting liquidity” to stUSDS holders, has shown volatility in the stUSDS/USDS exchange rate over the past week.
The pool’s $2 million of liquidity is currently made up of over 90% stUSDS, leading to the price divergence.
Prior to current developments, the stUSDS/USDS exchange rate was around 1.08, but the chart currently shows trading around par, with one particularly painful wick down to around 0.3.
Coincidentally, Curve Finance founder Michael Egorov previously pulled a similar strategy, borrowing multimillion sums of various stablecoins against his governance tokens, resulting in a liquidation cascade and plummeting CRV price in 2023.
Read more: Curve Finance founder Michael Egorov hit amid $22M CRV liquidation cascade
North Korean hackers also using Sky
While the stUSDS supply of $160 million is not to be sniffed at, it’s dwarfed by Sky’s overall stablecoin supply of $6.5 billion between USDS and legacy DAI.
These tokens maintain their dollar value via the protocol’s peg stability module (PSM), a 1:1 stablecoin exchange which has caught presumably unwanted attention.
CoinDesk reports that over half a billion dollars of illicit transactions have flown through the PSM over the years, including over $100 million tied to North Korean hackers.
With US authorities enthusiastically taking to freezing stablecoins in response to October’s Binance hack, some began to worry about the risk to pooled DeFi assets should the contracts holding commingled illicit funds be frozen.
Read more: LIVE: Binance says it’s yet to open up more token withdrawals
Possibly out of an abundance of caution, a Poloniex-labelled wallet reportedly converted $1.5 billion of USDS and sUSDS via Sky’s PSM, depositing the USDC into Aave.
Sky has played down the threat, noting that front ends block sanctioned entities and stressing that the funds flagged by CoinDesk “represent roughly 0.03%” of the almost $1 trillion of volume the PSM has processed to date.
