Anthropic IPO获约5000亿美元认购需求，指数基金首月或买入2.77亿股

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据《金融时报》报道，尽管不少投资者对 Anthropic 的高估值、巨额资本开支和模型同质化风险存有疑虑，他们仍将其视为一只「必买股」。Anthropic 将 IPO 发行价定为每股 83 美元，高于此前 70 至 78 美元的区间，发行规模也从原方案上限约 640 亿美元扩大至约 810 亿美元，完全摊薄估值约为 1.5 万亿美元。承销商据悉获得约 5000 亿美元的认购需求，但认购订单可能被高报，不能等同于上市后的实际买盘。

Anthropic 是首家登陆公开市场、业务聚焦前沿 AI 模型开发的大型公司。投资者此前可通过谷歌、亚马逊等公司间接参与这一赛道，但这与直接持有 Anthropic 不同。对基金经理而言，即便对发行价有疑虑，若不配置而股价随后大涨，也可能面临业绩落后于同行的压力。

指数基金可能带来另一批买盘。Intropic 估计，若 Anthropic 符合相关指数的纳入条件，指数追踪基金可能在上市首月分四次买入约 2.77 亿股，相当于扩大后基础发行股数的约 28%。对这些基金而言，是否买入取决于指数规则，而非对估值的判断。

上市后也可能出现较大卖盘。部分非创始人内部人士最多可从首个交易日起出售所持股份的 10%，合计约 3.16 亿股，按发行价计算价值约 260 亿美元。这些股份具备出售资格，不代表持有人已经卖出。若首日表现强劲，部分获配基金也可能选择获利了结。

此外，同步进行的 260 亿美元私募配售包含芯片、算力和晶圆代工供应商。这些战略投资方一边向 Anthropic 投资，一边也是其基础设施开支的受益方，买入动机与普通基金不同。此次 IPO 能以更高价格扩大规模，并不意味着上市后仍有同样强的买盘；真正的考验是，尚未获配的投资者是否愿意在更高价位继续买入。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378219

items.content:
Anthropic前员工：Amodei曾谈公司未来可能比政府更强大，超级AI就像「魔戒」

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 即将上市，不少员工有望一夜暴富。但《纽约时报》采访发现，一些人眼下更关心的是：如果公司率先造出超级智能，究竟会获得多大的权力？

《纽约时报》专栏作者 Jasmine Sun 在过去两年采访了数十名 Anthropic 创始人、员工和离职者。一位匿名离职员工透露，CEO Dario Amodei 曾谈到，Anthropic 未来可能比政府更有权势，因此需要与各个国家建立自己的关系。

另一位离职员工则用《指环王》里的「魔戒」比喻超级智能。谁先造出来，谁就可能掌握最危险的网络武器、治愈各种疾病的方法，以及一支不知疲倦的 AI 大军。如此强大的力量一旦集中在少数人手中，掌握它的人是否值得信任，就变得至关重要。

Amodei 对这场竞赛的态度也发生了明显变化。2022 年，他曾公开表示，Anthropic 不应该抢跑，也不该训练远比同行更大的模型。当年，公司甚至因为安全顾虑，暂缓向公众推出 Claude，随后 OpenAI 凭借 ChatGPT 抢占了市场先机。

如今，Amodei 认为 AI 竞赛已经无法阻止。如果 Anthropic 不率先研发出最先进的模型，其他公司也会继续推进。只有保持领先，Anthropic 才有足够的影响力，推动整个行业采用更安全的做法。

这种使命感也深入了 Anthropic 的招聘流程。公司有一道著名的面试题：如果为了 AI 安全放慢研发，导致你的股票价值归零，你还愿意在这里工作吗？研究团队甚至会拒绝技术能力出众、但不认同公司理念的候选人。

随着公司快速扩张，内部开始出现分歧。一些早期员工担心，新加入的销售和市场人员只是冲着高薪与股票而来，未必真正相信公司的安全使命。还有员工主张立即停止训练更强的 AI，即使 OpenAI 等竞争对手不会跟着停，但遭到 Amodei 否决。

Anthropic 即将通过 IPO 获得巨额资金，继续购买算力、研发更强的模型。与此同时，公司还在争取国会给予反垄断豁免，以便未来能够与其他美国 AI 实验室协调放慢研发。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378218

Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.
Swedish Bitcoin treasury company H100 Group said Thursday it could use Bitcoin from its trading pool to fund share buybacks if shareholders approve the plan next month.
The pool lost about 30 Bitcoin (BTC) in the third quarter and held 233.4 BTC as of Sept. 30, H100 said in its quarterly report. The company held another 3,243.4 BTC in its long-term treasury.
Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether to authorize the board to buy back up to 10% of H100’s shares. H100 would pay shareholders in cash. New Swedish rules allowing companies on the NGM Growth Market to buy back their own shares take effect Dec. 5.
CEO Eirik Grøttum said in September that buybacks could make sense when H100 shares trade below net asset value.
H100 shares (NGM:H100) were up 6.5% at 1.53 Swedish kronor as of 11:45 a.m. Stockholm time Thursday (10:45 UTC), valuing the company at about $170 million. The 3,476.8 BTC it held on Sept. 30 would be worth about $222 million at Thursday’s Bitcoin price of $63,871.
The company reported a third-quarter net profit of 147.9 million kronor ($14.5 million) after recording a preliminary noncash gain of 171 million kronor on its August acquisition of Norwegian Bitcoin company NSD AS. Its operations lost 13.5 million kronor ($1.3 million) in the quarter.
The deal added 2,455 BTC to H100’s holdings. BitcoinTreasuries ranks H100 third among Europe’s publicly traded Bitcoin holders, behind Germany’s Bitcoin Group SE and France’s Capital B.

items.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen said publishers are making a mistake by releasing games only as digital downloads, on the eve of GTA 6's digital-only launch.
- Cohen said the shift has hurt both consumers and GameStop, whose sales of pre-owned products fell 32% year over year in its latest reported quarter.
- He has met with Rep. Ritchie Torres, who is backing a bill that would require gaming companies to give buyers ongoing access to the games they purchase.
GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen has criticized video game publishers for abandoning physical discs, as Grand Theft Auto 6, one of the most anticipated games ever made, launches on Thursday as a digital download only.
"When you buy a game, you should be able to sell it, trade it or lend it to a friend," Cohen told Bloomberg. "Unquestionably, the decision to move to all digital has hurt consumers, and it's also hurt GameStop."
Cohen declined to name specific companies, but Take-Two Interactive is releasing the $80 game only as a download, with retailers selling boxes containing download codes. Asked about presales, Cohen said: "It's a code in a box. I mean, we're selling a lot of it."
Take-Two declined to comment to Bloomberg.
Trade-ins under pressure
The shift hits a core part of GameStop's business. Pre-owned and refurbished products made up 22% of the retailer's sales, about $171 million, in the quarter that ended August 1, down 32% from a year earlier, according to Bloomberg.
Cohen said he has spoken with publishers, who he argued benefit from limiting trade-ins because used copies compete with new sales. "They're taking away competition," he said.
Sony announced in July that it will stop producing physical discs for new PlayStation games in January 2028, a move experts have said will hit low-income gamers hardest. PlayStation founder Ken Kutaragi has dismissed the backlash as a "mentality issue," while an Infinity Ward veteran said publishers have pushed to cut discs since 2007.
The fight over game ownership
Cohen said he has met with Rep. Ritchie Torres (D-NY), who is backing the Power to the Players Act, which would require gaming companies to give consumers ongoing access to the titles they buy. "A game that can be taken away the moment a company pulls the plug is not a purchase. It is a rental disguised as a sale," Torres said in October.
In Europe, the Stop Killing Games campaign gathered 1.3 million signatures for a European Citizens' Initiative calling for publishers to keep games playable after support ends.
The question of whether buyers own digital games has also reached the courts. Sony has argued in court that digital games can't be owned, prompting some in the crypto industry to pitch blockchain-based ownership as a fix.
Cohen's GameStop has also made bets beyond gaming. The company bought 4,710 BTC for more than $500 million in 2025, and in March moved all but one of them into a covered call strategy on Coinbase Prime to generate income. In May, after eBay rejected its takeover offer, GameStop sought shareholder approval to raise its authorized share count to 2.5 billion as it built a stake in the online marketplace.

IOSCO警告：先进量子计算机或在五年内破解金融业常用加密技术

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，国际证券委员会组织（IOSCO）11 月 19 日发布报告称，部分行业专家认为，未来五年内可能出现足以破解金融系统广泛使用的公钥密码技术的量子计算机。目前尚无已知量子计算机具备这种能力，五年是风险估计，并非确定时间表。但银行、支付网络和区块链的安全系统迁移可能耗时多年，IOSCO 呼吁金融机构现在就开始准备。

IOSCO 在这份 63 页的报告中指出，多数受观察机构仍处于排查易受影响的系统、培训员工或制定迁移计划的阶段，真正开始测试或部署抗量子方案的机构相对较少。一些机构已经意识到风险，却仍在等待监管要求更明确或技术更成熟。同日，英国央行、金融行为监管局和审慎监管局发布联合指引，建议金融机构梳理现有密码系统、制定分阶段替换计划，并评估技术供应商的准备情况。

对比特币和以太坊而言，风险主要涉及用于授权交易的数字签名。如果未来出现足够强大的量子计算机，公钥已公开的钱包可能面临私钥被推导、资产被盗的风险。即使区块链支持抗量子签名，未迁移到安全地址的旧钱包也不会自动受到保护。比特币开发者 Jameson Lopp 等人提出，在过渡期结束后限制未迁移的易受攻击资产继续使用旧签名转账；反对者认为，这可能阻止合法持有人动用自己的比特币。该方案仍是提案，并非已生效的网络规则。

迁移也可能带来性能和成本压力。IOSCO 援引的研究显示，部分抗量子签名的数据大小约为主流区块链现用签名的 35 至 40 倍。在一项 Solana 测试网实验中，换用抗量子签名后，交易吞吐量下降约 90%。这一数字来自特定测试，并非 Solana 主网的实际表现，也不代表其他抗量子方案会出现同等降幅。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378216

items.content:
OpenAI总裁Greg持有近300亿美元OpenAI股权，Sam后悔：当年该听他的

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 18 日，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 和总裁 Greg Brockman 一同出席《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会。主持人 Andrew Ross Sorkin 当面提起两人的巨大财富反差：Greg 持有价值约 300 亿美元的 OpenAI 股权，Sam 却没有直接持股。

主持人问，这是否影响两人的关系？将来 OpenAI 上市，Sam 会不会也获得同等规模的股权？

Sam 表示，两人的关系完全没有受到影响，但没有回答自己未来是否会拿股权。

Greg 随后透露，当年筹划公司架构时，他曾明确建议 Sam 接受股权。这也是两人少有的分歧之一。但 Sam 坚持不拿，Greg 最终尊重了他的选择。

Sam 听完承认：「我当初真该听 Greg 的。」他还表示，不拿股权这件事后来给他带来了不少麻烦。

Sam 前不久刚解释过后悔的原因。今年 10 月，他接受《Vanity Fair》采访时表示，当初拒绝股权，是希望自己能够不受个人经济利益影响，为人类的未来做决策。但他发现，这个决定反而破坏了外界对他的信任。

他还曾公开抱怨，人们很容易理解一个 CEO 为赚钱而努力，却很难相信有人只是因为喜欢技术、希望影响技术和社会的发展，才如此投入工作。

items.author: Jacob Lyon
items.content:
The European Commission has been targeted in a cyberattack that may have seen some employees’ personal data stolen, according to Politico.
The cyberattack reportedly disrupted the Commission for 10 days and affected Sysper, the HR management portal it uses to process payslips and leave requests. It also affected its medical reimbursement system MyPMO.
Security checks were upped in response, and the commission’s Corporate Management Board called urgent meetings to discuss the “ongoing cyber incidents.”
Both Sysper and MyPMO are mostly functioning again. An EU official told the Politico, “The Commission believes it has contained most of the attack, but the full extent of any damage remains unclear.”
Read more: European supermarket fridges hacked again
The European Commission suspects that an AI-powered tool called ARTEX gave the hackers a way to identify vulnerabilities in its IT systems.
As for whether or not personal data was breached, investigators are still figuring it out, and the commission doesn’t know yet.
This incident is just another in a string of cybersecurity breaches that have plagued Western infrastructure over the past few months, including hacked fridges and crypto malware deployed across hundreds of major big-name websites.

谷歌推出Stitch Loop：AI全天盯着线上数据，自动找问题、改代码、验证效果

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google Labs 推出新实验产品 Stitch Loop，让 AI 智能体在软件上线后继续工作。原来的 Stitch 主要负责设计界面，新产品则能持续监测真实运营数据，发现问题、修改代码，再检查改动有没有效果。

开发者只需设定目标，比如提高购物网站的结账转化率。Stitch Loop 就会分析用户行为、运行日志和反馈，寻找影响转化的问题，提出改进方案。用户选定方案后，AI 会在隔离的云端环境中编写代码，提交 PR（代码修改请求），等待人工审核。

改动上线后，AI 还会继续追踪指标。如果效果不理想，就寻找下一轮改进机会。即使目标达成，也会持续监测，防止效果回退。

Stitch Loop 默认提供三类自动优化任务：网络安全、运行速度和无障碍适配。其中，安全任务结合 Gemini 4 Carbon 与 Google DeepMind 的 CodeMender，自动扫描代码漏洞并提出修复方案。

它支持连接 GitHub，通过 180 多种集成、MCP 和命令行工具获取产品数据，也能为 Antigravity 等编程智能体提供持续更新的产品上下文。

谷歌此前的 Jules 已能定期执行安全修补、性能优化等任务，但该产品已于 11 月 11 日转为只读，计划年底关闭。Stitch Loop 进一步把代码维护与真实业务指标结合起来。

目前 Stitch Loop 仍处于实验阶段，全球用户均可申请加入候补名单，符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户享有优先体验资格。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378215

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 为 Claude Code 加入实验性 Code Mode，已在 11 月 12 日发布的 v2.1.323 中上线，目前需要手动开启。

启用后，Claude 可以先编写 JavaScript 脚本，再通过脚本连续、并行调用多个工具，还能把工具返回的数据先处理好，只将必要结果交给模型，从而减少模型请求和 Token 消耗。

Code Mode 由 Cloudflare 于 2025 年 9 月提出，Anthropic 同年 11 月也公开了类似方案。今年，DeepSeek Harness、Pi 和 OpenCode 2.0 等开源 Agent 框架陆续加入支持。

Anthropic 如今才将其集成进 Claude Code，目前仍处于实验阶段，需要手动开启。

items.author: Gino Matos
items.content:
Quick Take
- Bitcoin hovered near $62,000 as Fed minutes revealed overwhelming support for further rate hikes, while gold and silver suffered steep losses.
- Rising Treasury yields and a stronger dollar threaten Bitcoin as stablecoin supply shrinks by $16 billion and ETF investors withdraw over $310 million.
- Bitcoin faces a potential liquidation wave between $59,500 and $62,200, raising concerns that another decline could trigger more forced selling.
Bitcoin, gold, and silver had already fallen on Wednesday before the Federal Reserve released its October meeting minutes.
Almost all participants at the October meeting judged that further rate increases would likely be appropriate in the months ahead under their baseline outlooks for inflation and employment.
Bitcoin traded in the $62,000 zone for most of the day after the minutes, while spot gold closed down 3% to $3,741.82 an ounce, and silver fell 5.3% to $44.88 an ounce. Gold had touched its lowest level since September 2025 earlier in the session.
Even after the minutes, CME FedWatch odds were 92% for a quarter-point hike in December and 8% for a half-point move.
Analysts linked the drop in bullion to the stronger dollar, rising Treasury yields and expectations of tighter policy. Gold pays no interest, so rising yields increase the cost of holding it instead of putting cash into interest-bearing assets.
The Silver Institute’s 2026 market forecast projects a 3% decline in overall industrial use, even as demand outside photovoltaics is expected to grow 4.5%. The institute still expects total silver demand to exceed supply by 35 million ounces this year.
The October minutes show a committee that held its target range at 3.75% to 4.00% by a 10-2 vote.
Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack preferred a quarter-point increase, while a couple of participants said a move larger than 25 basis points could warrant consideration at the next meeting if inflation data were unfavorable.
Bitget analyst Lewis Huang shared in a note that the record points to wider backing for a hike than the vote count shows. He said:
“The minutes suggest broader support for an October hike than the 10–2 vote alone implied—and that was before payrolls and CPI both came in hot. Governor Waller has said a half-point increase should be considered; evidence that other officials were already open to that scale of tightening in October could push the odds of a 50-basis-point move higher.”
Huang pointed to yields and the dollar as the channel into Bitcoin, saying that a further rise in yields and the dollar would add pressure to Bitcoin, which is now trading well below its 200-week moving average near $68,000. Gold could also struggle if real yields keep climbing.
Fabian Dori, chief investment officer at Sygnum Bank, sees the same path. He said:
“Markets already price a run of hikes into next year, and the minutes suggest the committee was leaning that way even before October’s hot CPI.”
Dori added that this likely keeps long-term yields and the dollar firm, and the question for Bitcoin is whether debasement concerns and advancing institutional adoption can outweigh it.
Fed staff also outlined that falling prices could force investors to sell assets to cut borrowing, while withdrawals could force fund managers to raise cash.
In very severe scenarios, sales by hedge funds, bond mutual funds and target-date funds could be large enough to impair market functioning. Staff were concerned that selling into a falling market could push prices down further and strain trading.
What would signal a Bitcoin rebound?
A softer dollar and lower Treasury yields would ease some pressure on markets, and Bitcoin’s own demand gauges give investors another way to judge a rebound.
Farside Investors’ ETF flow table shows over $310 million in net outflows from US spot Bitcoin funds on Nov. 17 and 18.
Glassnode’s Nov. 17 analysis estimated that about 20% of the coins held by short-term holders were acquired between $62,000 and $66,000. That puts Wednesday’s reported price near the low end of a range where many recent buyers entered.
Using the same Nov. 17 data, Glassnode modeled a cluster of potential long liquidations between $59,500 and $62,200, where a renewed decline could force some leveraged positions to close.
Glassnode puts short-term holders’ overall cost basis at $74,100, and a return to that level would bring recent buyers back around break-even as a group.
Huang named the weekend low as the level to watch:
“For Bitcoin, a break below the weekend low near $62,000 could extend the sell-off,” he said.
Stablecoin supply had shrunk 4.2% over 90 days, and Bitcoin briefly traded at a premium on Coinbase around the November low before slipping back to a small discount relative to the global price.
Georges Chouchani, founder and CEO of Euclid, links the minutes to that cash shortage:
“The minutes show support for a hike went well beyond the two officials who voted for one in October, so markets start pricing more hikes after December.”
He said that this keeps yields and the dollar firm, and it hits a crypto market already short of cash. Stablecoin supply, the dollar tokens crypto trades with, has fallen by about $16 billion over the past month, its steepest drop since June 2022, so there are fewer buyers to absorb the selling, and Bitcoin takes the hit.
A premium that holds, sustained ETF inflows, or a leveling off in stablecoin supply would give investors more evidence that demand is returning.
items.title: Bitcoin faces fresh $60,000 threat as Fed minutes reveal overwhelming support for more rate hikes

分析：BTC高成本套牢盘割肉持续，承接区逐步下移，短期宜「多看少动」等待恐慌出清

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，链上分析师 Murphy 发文称，通过 URPD 数据观察当前比特币筹码的移动轨迹与情绪反馈。首先，短期持有者（STH）的筹码总量每天在增加，这意味着长期持有者（LTH）持续派发的速度快于 STH 持币满 6 个月转化为 LTH 的速度，供大于求令价格持续承压，STH 净增长在 11 月 13 日达到近 1.5 万枚的峰值。其次，高成本区的套牢筹码仍在持续割肉离场，主要集中在 75,000 至 81,000 美元区间，目前尚未看到明显减缓的趋势。同时，市场的承接区间正逐步下移，从 12 至 14 日的 65,000 至 72,000 美元下移至 15 至 17 日的 58,000 至 72,000 美元，且承接量较前几天有所减弱，显示部分资金开始变得谨慎。

整体来看，短期内市场情绪对多头不利，派发没有明显减弱，承接盘显得犹豫，但市场仍未放弃抵抗。分析师指出，目前 81,000 美元以上的套牢盘已减少抛售，接下来重点为等待 75,000 美元以上的恐慌盘彻底释放。在一轮猛烈的快速下杀中，「边打边退」也许是最明智的选择，当前依然维持「多看、少动」的观点，只能用时间慢慢消化抛压，还远没有到大举反攻的时候。

OpenAI董事长创办的AI客服公司，半年估值拟翻倍至300亿美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 董事长、Salesforce 前联席 CEO Bret Taylor 创办的 AI 客服公司 Sierra，正洽谈融资约 15 亿美元，目标估值高达 300 亿美元。

Lightspeed、Greenoaks 和 Benchmark 正考虑投资，谈判仍处于早期。Sierra 今年 5 月刚以 158 亿美元估值融资 9.5 亿美元。仅过半年，估值就有望接近翻倍。

Sierra 成立于 2023 年，专门帮企业部署 AI 客服。它的智能体不仅能接听电话、回答问题，还能连接企业内部系统，处理退款、订单变更等事务。客户包括摩根大通、Cigna 等大型企业，部分业务按 AI 成功解决的问题收费。

它的收入增长也很快。Sierra 今年 10 月披露，年化经常性收入（ARR）已超过 4 亿美元，短短 5 个月翻了一倍。仅第三季度就新增超过 1.5 亿美元。按目前披露的收入规模计算，300 亿美元估值约相当于 ARR 的 75 倍。

竞争对手 Decagon 也在筹备新一轮数亿美元融资，其今年第二季度末年化收入约 1 亿美元，预计年底达到 1.75 亿至 2 亿美元。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.
The International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) warned that upgrading blockchains to withstand quantum attacks could slow transactions and raise fees.
In a report released Thursday, IOSCO said some quantum-resistant digital signatures take up far more space than those used to authorize transactions today. Larger signatures mean fewer transactions can fit in each block, which could increase congestion, push up fees and require more storage.
IOSCO cited an experiment in which a test version of Solana ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures.
No known quantum computer can break the cryptography that secures these networks today. IOSCO urged firms to start preparing now because the transition could take years.
IOSCO said layer-1 networks use cryptography both to authorize transactions and to reach agreement on which blocks to add. Even after an upgrade, funds in dormant wallets and applications could remain vulnerable if they still rely on older keys.
Layer-2 networks can use quantum-resistant proofs to verify transactions and still depend on vulnerable systems to settle those transactions, move assets between chains or approve upgrades.
In April, Bitcoin advocate Samson Mow warned that larger post-quantum signatures could reduce Bitcoin’s throughput and that rushed fixes might introduce new vulnerabilities.
In October, Starknet’s community backed research into becoming an independent, quantum-resistant layer-1 network, following concerns over its reliance on Ethereum’s security upgrade timeline.
Ethereum researcher Justin Drake has since outlined a 2028 post-quantum transition target, ahead of the network’s existing 2029 roadmap.
Related: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
items.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps

豆包音视频通话模型开放API：AI能边看边听边说，还会主动开口

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 19 日，火山引擎正式开放豆包实时音视频模型 SeedRealtime 1.0 的 API。该模型今年 8 月就已在豆包 App 上线，如今第三方开发者也能将这套实时视频通话能力接入自己的产品。

SeedRealtime 将摄像头画面、声音和时间顺序放进同一个端到端模型。AI 可以一边观察、一边听用户说话，同时判断该什么时候开口，减少传统语音识别、视觉理解、语音合成等多个模块串联带来的延迟和信息损失。

官方演示中，用户把整颗咖啡豆倒进咖啡机的萃取手柄，AI 不等提问就主动提醒先研磨。逛博物馆时，用户只需提前交代要找哪件文物，模型便能持续观察镜头，在目标出现时主动提醒。它还能分辨多人对话，在嘈杂环境中避免被旁人的闲聊误触发。

字节跳动今年 8 月公布的人工评测显示，相比多个模型串联的方案，SeedRealtime 的音视频对话节奏问题减少约一半，抢话、回应迟缓和背景噪声误触发等现象明显减少。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
Bitcoin is struggling to hold the $64,000 level as investors continue to pull money from spot Bitcoin ETFs and brace for another interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve.
The leading cryptocurrency was trading at around $63,800 on Thursday, down 1% on the day and 13% over the past week, according to Decrypt data. It has hovered between roughly $63,000 and $65,000 since the weekend, briefly dipping below $63,000 and touching a 24-hour low of $62,068, per CoinGecko data.
"Bitcoin remains under selling pressure," Daniela Hathorn, senior market analyst at Capital.com, told Decrypt, noting that it has fallen roughly 26% from its late-September peak near $87,000. "Elevated Treasury yields, dollar strength and expectations of further Fed tightening are weighing on risk appetite, while the broader technology selloff has added to the pressure."
ETF outflows mount
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $306.4 million in net outflows on Wednesday, after $239.9 million on Tuesday, according to SoSoValue data. The funds have seen outflows on nine of the past 10 trading days, with Monday's small $8 million inflow the only exception, and have lost about $2.9 billion so far in November. Their total net assets have fallen to $77.7 billion. Bitcoin miners have added to the selling, with major miners including Riot and MARA selling some of their holdings to fund a shift into AI infrastructure.
Monday's brief inflow "does not signal a market inflection point," Tim Sun, senior researcher at HashKey, told Decrypt. Net short positions in Bitcoin futures held by leveraged funds on CME have fallen to their lowest level since early 2023, and futures basis yields have narrowed, he said, indicating that hedge funds have largely unwound the basis trade that paired spot ETF purchases with short futures. That means the current outflows are mainly driven by investors actively cutting their Bitcoin exposure, Sun said.
"If macro expectations do not improve, investors may shift from buying the dip to selling into rallies, creating additional overhead resistance on subsequent rebounds," he added.
"Recent Bitcoin ETF outflows and leveraged liquidations" have amplified the decline, Hathorn said. "Despite stronger Nvidia earnings, the market has struggled to stage a significant rebound, suggesting confidence remains fragile. A sustained recovery may require renewed ETF inflows and a more supportive interest-rate outlook."
Some traders have also pointed the finger at Anthropic's upcoming IPO for drawing money away from crypto, though analysts have disputed that the listing is draining crypto liquidity, attributing it instead to ETF outflows, forced selling and rising interest rates.
Traders see a 90.7% chance that the Fed will raise rates by a quarter point at its December 9 meeting, and a 9.3% chance of a half-point hike, according to CME FedWatch. The odds of a half-point move have risen from 6.5% a day earlier. Fed Governor Christopher Waller has called for an even bigger, half-point increase, unless policymakers signal another rise in January.
Levels to watch
Hathorn said $64,000 is the immediate level to watch, followed by support around $62,000 and the psychological $60,000 mark. A sustained recovery above $66,000 to $68,000 could ease selling pressure, "but the broader trend remains bearish while lower highs persist," she said.
Onchain analytics firm Glassnode said in its weekly report on Tuesday that the crash had pushed investors’ realized losses to levels seen only near past market lows in 2018, 2020, 2022 and early 2023, a sign of capitulation. Bitcoin is now holding a dense block of recent buyers between $62,000 and $66,000, which grew by about 66,000 BTC during the two days of heaviest selling, Glassnode said. But a daily close below that block could set off a fast drop toward the June low of $58,500, and the Realized Price, the average price at which all Bitcoin last moved, at $53,700.
Traders on Decrypt Predict see a 43% chance that Bitcoin will fall to $60,000 at some point before the end of November, and a 12% chance that it will drop as low as $55,000. They give just a 2% chance that it will climb back to $82,500 this month.
There are some signs of support. About 1.1 million BTC, roughly 5.5% of supply, last changed hands at prices between $60,000 and $64,000, and that band has grown by more than 25,000 BTC in recent days, according to Neil Steinhardt, head of Nexo U.S., in a note shared with Decrypt Wednesday. A dense base of holders with costs near current prices "can act as a support zone, though it is not a floor," he wrote.
Bitcoin has also held up better than gold. The amount of gold one Bitcoin buys rose above its 200-day average this week, to about 17.1 ounces, around 40% above its March low, Steinhardt said.

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- CoinShares raised $19.3 million in October by selling its entire treasury Ethereum position and half its treasury Solana.
- Quarter-end assets under management rose to $7.4 billion, while management fees held at $19.1 million as the rally came late.
- CoinShares had $358.1 million of net digital assets on loan at September’s close, leaving it exposed to borrower defaults.
CoinShares Chief Executive Jean-Marie Mognetti said on Nov. 18 that October’s sale of the firm’s entire corporate treasury Ethereum position and half its treasury Solana freed up $19.3 million for potential share repurchases.
The company’s third-quarter earnings show how its shareholders remain exposed to crypto prices through its remaining holdings and the fees it charges on investment products.
CoinShares raised $16.6 million from the Ethereum sale and $2.7 million from Solana. Together, they amounted to about 48% of the board’s $40 million repurchase authorization.
The board approved the program on Oct. 22, and CoinShares announced it on Oct. 27, with a run time until the next annual meeting, expected in the second quarter of 2027. Purchases depend on market conditions, blackout periods, and trading-volume limits.
Before the sale, CoinShares held $43.2 million in treasury digital assets, including 235 Bitcoin worth $19.6 million, as of Sept. 30, according to its interim financial statements.
The treasury also held $17.6 million in Ethereum and $5.9 million in Solana at that date. The October disclosure identified sales of Ethereum and Solana, with half the Solana position retained.
The filing separately lists $4.1 billion of digital assets held for operations as of Sept. 30, including $880.5 million of Ethereum and $407.8 million of Solana. Some of those assets back exchange-traded products or hedge its obligations to product holders.
How crypto prices still reach earnings
Assets under management climbed from $5.5 billion at the June close to $7.4 billion at the September close.
The $125 million in quarterly net inflows accounted for about 7% of the increase, with price appreciation adding roughly $1.75 billion, based on CoinShares’ first-half and nine-month figures. At its CoinShares Physical platform alone, prices added $938.4 million and net inflows added $77.8 million.
CoinShares reported that management fees held at $19.1 million in both quarters. The fees accrue on daily assets, and the late-quarter rally lifted the September closing balance more than the average fee base.
The total also includes seed assets that pay no fees, with CoinShares reporting $6.4 billion in fee-paying assets at quarter-end.
The asset manager had $358.1 million of digital assets on loan as of Sept. 30, after accounting for expected credit losses, up from $69.8 million at the end of 2025. Some loans are unsecured, so the firm can lose money if a borrower defaults.
Management said it shifted Ethereum from staking into lending during the third quarter, and the loan book earned $4.3 million in interest that quarter, alongside $2.8 million in staking revenue.
Stronger lending and trading lifted capital markets segment revenue and gains to $17.8 million from $4.9 million in the second quarter.
The third-quarter segment figure comprised $8.6 million in revenue and $9.2 million in operating gains. CoinShares reported $27.7 million in consolidated revenue, including asset management fees.
An unrealized $9.6 million gain came from the gap between the value of cash-redeemable XBT certificates and the assets CoinShares holds to hedge them. The gain was reflected in the company’s $28.4 million of operating income and excluded from the $17.8 million segment figure.
A $14.4 million treasury revaluation gain was recorded below operating income and helped lift net income to $39.6 million.
CoinShares said its expanded monthly tracker adds lending, staking and treasury figures to the existing product assets and flows data.
That gives investors a way to track what the company holds and what it puts to work, while measuring buyback execution separately by the shares the company reports purchasing.
items.title: CoinShares unloads $19.3M in ETH and SOL, yet keeps crypto risk

OpenAI让AI改进AMD旗舰GPU：5个月推进约1年的优化，部分成果已送厂制造

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 不光向 AMD 采购 GPU，现在还让自己的 AI 帮 AMD 改进芯片设计。

AMD 的旗舰 GPU 电路已经由工程师反复优化多年，但 OpenAI 的模型仍找到了最高 14% 的改进空间。OpenAI 称，双方在不到 5 个月内，完成了通常需要约一年才能取得的优化进展。

AI 会直接修改描述芯片电路的代码，尝试更高效的计算和数据传输方式，再调用专业软件验证功能是否正确、功耗和性能有没有改善。AMD 已将部分修改用于最近送厂制造的芯片设计，其余成果也被纳入后续产品。

OpenAI 在开发自研推理芯片 Jalapeño 时，就已经让 AI 参与电路设计。这次与 AMD 的合作证明，即使是经验丰富的工程师反复优化过的芯片，AI 也能找到新的改进方案，并被实际用于产品设计。

Anthropic或让4250名员工跻身百万富翁，财富开始涌向旧金山房市和奢侈品

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 正式敲定每股 83 美元的 IPO 发行价。未上市公司股票交易平台 Hill 之前估算，这次上市可能让约 4250 名员工成为百万美元富翁，占公司约 5300 名员工的 80%。其中约 1200 人持股价值超过 1000 万美元，50 人超过 1 亿美元。

蚂蚁国际推出Whale Orchestration Protocol，打通代币化存款与货币市场基金

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，蚂蚁国际宣布推出 Whale Orchestration Protocol，作为其区块链批发结算平台 WhaleRTP 的重大升级，并在新加坡金融管理局 BLOOM 倡议下，实现代币化存款与代币化货币市场基金之间的券款对付（DvP）。该协议可在 WhaleRTP 上完成安全、原子化结算，缩短传统基金结算时滞，使闲置资金可实时用于全球司库管理。蚂蚁国际已与星展银行、富兰克林邓普顿完成试点交易，后两者分别将 Treasury Tokens 和代币化货币市场基金方案接入 WhaleRTP。蚂蚁国际称，这是新加坡首次实现这两类代币化资产的跨资产互通。

蚂蚁国际、星展银行和富兰克林邓普顿同为 BLOOM 参与方，共同牵头跨资产互通工作组，并在新加坡金融科技节上发布了 BLOOM Field Guide，同时推出介绍该协议的白皮书。蚂蚁国际平台技术总经理、高级副总裁 Kelvin Li 表示，将与更多合作方推广该方案，为全球企业提供新一代司库管理能力。

--- Top Comments ---

[varenc]: As others have said, macOS does this by default and it's quite impressive. I have a long running daemon with a memory leak. By its nature, the leaking memory is very repetitive and easily compressed. Right now this daemon has tried to claim 2.5GB of memory, but it's been compressed to a mere 450MB of actual memory! And because it's a memory leak, it never accesses this old stuff, so it never gets decompressed. Only 20MB of RAM is held that isn't compressed. Of course, it w...

[Lio]: RAM compression sounds very useful but the thing I really need extra RAM for is local inference. Since the models are effectively highly compressed data already my assumption is that RAM compression won't help improve that much (I'm assuming unified memory here as per the Framework Desktop).  A bit like trying to compress a JPEG in a zip file. Could anyone comment on that?

[hedgehog]: As others have noted zswap is usually a better choice than zram, additionally depending on your situation it may be worth checking which algorithm it's using as there are a few choices (zstd, lz4, etc) and the defaults vary by distro. zstd is the right choice IMO unless you're in a situation where you know better.

[jakozaur]: > Memory compression is not new. If you have a Windows or Mac device you are already using it. Yes, macOS has had it enabled by default since OS X Mavericks 10.9, released in October 2013. I’m surprised some desktop Linux distributions still require manual configuration to enable it. For browser tabs, though, I think a better solution is automatic tab closing, using something like the Tab Wrangler extension for Chrome. Collecting tabs comes naturally; we’re much worse at closing them.

[flowerlad]: In the 1990s there was a third-party add-on for Windows called SoftRAM95 [1] that doubled your RAM using compression. That one turned out to be a scam though [2]. [1]  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SoftRAM  [2]  https://devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20211111-00/?p=10...

items.content:
Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) issued 100 million Singapore dollars ($77.5 million) in tokenized bills on Nov. 6, with banks using wholesale central bank digital currency (CBDC) to pay for them.
Five banks submitted bids totaling more than twice the amount on offer, MAS said Thursday. The four-week bills mature on Dec. 4.
MAS issued the bills directly on the Singapore Dollar Test Network. That gives borrowers an asset they could pledge as collateral for loans on the network, the central bank said.
Singapore began experimenting with blockchain-based bank payments in 2016. In 2025, banks used the test network and MAS-issued digital currency to settle overnight loans.
MAS now plans to turn the Singapore Dollar Test Network, where the bills were issued, into a settlement system for financial institutions, Managing Director Chia Der Jiun said Thursday at the Singapore FinTech Festival. The network will be renamed SG Digital Ledger.
“As the use of tokenized assets and digital money grows, trusted settlement on CBDC will be needed,” Chia said. “It underpins settlement finality and confidence, especially for large value settlement.”
In 2027, MAS plans to issue more tokenized bills, bring more financial institutions into the trials and expand the bills’ use as collateral.
Related: Singapore advances asset tokenization with new MAS frameworks
items.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC

数据：10枚以上比特币钱包数创年内新高，但整体供应量仍在流失

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，市场情绪分析机构 Santiment 发布数据，持有 10 枚以上 BTC 的「10+ BTC Club」钱包数量已增至 150,770 个，创下 2026 年 1 月以来的最高纪录。然而，该群体在过去四周内累计抛售了超 1 万枚 BTC。目前这些大钱包总共持有约 1666 万枚 BTC，占全网供应量的 82.85%，平均每个钱包持仓约 110.5 枚。这呈现出一种背离状态：大户钱包的数量在增加，但该群体掌控的总供应量却在快速下降。

分析指出，近期比特币价格跌至 63,000 美元附近，促使更多小规模钱包达到了 10 枚 BTC 的持仓门槛，但这批大户的整体行动方向对多头依然不利。分析师强调，市场下一个真正的看涨确认信号，并非仅仅是钱包数量的增长，而是其持有供应量的回升。当这 82.85% 的供应份额重新开始上升时，才能说明这些核心大玩家正转向激进积累，这将构成更具说服力的反弹信号。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- The World Bank Group will explore settling development payments in USDC with Citi and Circle in eligible borrower countries.
- The World Bank Group says FundsChain tracks disbursements for more than 350 projects across 96 countries under existing payment procedures.
- The announcement leaves open where USDC would enter the payment chain and what currency recipients would receive.
The World Bank Group said Nov. 17 that it would work with Citi and Circle to explore using USDC to settle development payments.
The group wants to see whether a dollar stablecoin can make those payments faster, cheaper, and more transparent.
Under the proposal, Citi would provide links to established banking networks, while Circle’s infrastructure would help issue USDC and settle payments in it.
The World Bank would examine where that route could work alongside its existing arrangements, which rely on correspondent banks to handle payments across banking networks.
The initial exploration will engage borrower countries where digital assets are supported and permitted and focus on an intermediary-based model. The World Bank gave no launch date or list of participating borrowers, and said it would explore working with other banks over time.
What FundsChain already does with USDC
The World Bank uses its original FundsChain platform to give project teams a record of where development money goes.
Authorized users can trace payments from the initial disbursement to the final recipient and inspect supporting documents. The group says more than 350 projects across 96 countries are on the tracking platform.
Borrowers use the same process to apply for withdrawals, and projects continue paying suppliers and beneficiaries as before. FundsChain lets project teams document transactions through designated project accounts and local accounts farther down the payment chain.
The records can also feed into expenditure statements that borrowers submit through the bank’s client portal.
Linking an invoice to a transaction lets authorized reviewers check what a payment covered. That oversight can extend beyond the initial transfer to a borrower and into the spending that happens within a project.
The bank has separately explored whether it can build spending rules into payments themselves. In a July update, it said a FundsChain Evolution pilot had gone live in Ethiopia using programmable money to place conditions on how the funds can be spent.
The proposal leaves open where USDC would enter the payment chain, whether recipients would get tokens, and how any tokens would be converted to local currency.
Those details would determine what the change in settlement would mean for the people and organizations that ultimately receive the money.
items.title: Citi and Circle join World Bank in tests with USDC, unlocking a massive aid shift

[lukax]: OpenStack Swift uses SQLite for storing metadata. Each account has one SQLite db. Each container also initially had one SQLite db but in 2018 they added support for sharding so if a container has more than 1 million objects, the container is split into multiple SQLite databases. The performance is not ideal. Ceph scales much better.

[articulatepang]: I wonder if they tried storing diffs instead, and compacting them once in a while. These are user preferences for UI setup, and they have a lot of write traffic. But probably each user changes their preferences only by a little bit each time. Their 1MB writes would go down to just the small diffs. They could store the diffs and transparently apply them before sending to the client. After some timeout or maybe after a certain number of diffs have accumulated, squash them all and write back. [bob1029]: > JSON blobs An alternative to faster blob storage is to represent the blob's schema in SQL directly. If most blob updates are incremental you can eliminate a significant amount of storage IO and garbage collection this way. One SQLite database per blob type with a metadata SQLite db that tracks each. We could leverage powerful AI reasoning models to produce SQLite schemas and virtual table adapters for each encountered JSON schema type.

Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.
US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) ended Wednesday with $77.7 billion in net assets, a three-month low, as net outflows for the year topped $2.5 billion.
The funds recorded $306.4 million in net outflows on Wednesday, according to SoSoValue data. The funds held about 1.25 million Bitcoin (BTC) at Wednesday’s close, according to Walet Pilot.
BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) held the most Bitcoin, with about 779,870 BTC, followed by the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) with 172,080 BTC and Grayscale Bitcoin Trust (GBTC) with 122,730 BTC.
Bitcoin briefly dipped below $63,000 on Wednesday. It traded at $63,545 at publishing time, down 1.7% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko.
Vikram Subburaj, CEO of crypto exchange Giottus, said in a statement shared with Cointelegraph that institutional selling and expectations of tighter US monetary policy continued to weigh on market sentiment.
He also cited onchain data showing that long-term Bitcoin holders had reduced their positions by around 121,151 BTC over 30 days.
Selling pressure also extended to US spot Ether (ETH) ETFs, which recorded around $40 million in outflows Wednesday, bringing their 2026 net withdrawals to roughly $895 million.
Related: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
items.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B

韩国AI作弊风波升级：满分学霸直播自证前身亡，警方调查或将终止

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 19 日，韩国法学研究生入学考试（LEET）史上首位满分考生李振宇（32 岁），在首尔一家旅馆被发现身亡。

当天上午，他原本打算在媒体面前直播解答韩国高考语文试题，以证明自己的真实水平，回应 AI 作弊质疑，但最终没有现身。

李振宇曾自述，自己早年高考成绩只有第 6 至 8 等级（韩国实行九级制，数字越大成绩越差），后来却考入首尔大学牙科学院。今年 7 月，他又答对 LEET 全部 70 道题，成为这项考试自 2008 年设立以来首个满分考生。

争议来自他此前公开的一份试卷。其中连续 3 道题的涂改前答案，恰好对应上一道题的正确选项。网友怀疑，他可能在抄录外部提供的答案时发生错位。

韩国另一名税务师考试状元此前已承认，自己通过微型摄像头拍摄试题，再利用 AI 获取答案。这起案件让李振宇受到更多质疑。李振宇则坚决否认作弊，称试卷反复涂改是因为考试后半段注意力下降。

11 月 18 日，多名律师正式向警方举报李振宇。次日，他未能出席公开验证，随后被发现身亡。警方在现场找到疑似遗书的便条，内容提到身心疲惫，但没有承认作弊。目前具体死亡原因仍在调查。

由于当事人死亡，针对他的刑事调查预计将终止。不过，韩国教育部门已要求保留他此前参加高考的答卷，是否进一步调查作弊疑云尚未确定。

items.content:
BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.
BTCPay Server issued an emergency update to fix five security flaws in Nginx, urging operators of its self-hosted Bitcoin payment software to install it as soon as possible.
The vulnerabilities affect Nginx, the software that routes incoming web traffic to BTCPay’s payment application. The developers behind the Bitcoin payment software said the update installs Nginx version 1.31.9.
According to a Wednesday advisory from the European Union’s cybersecurity response team, CERT-EU, the flaws could allow attackers to remotely run malicious code on vulnerable servers without logging in.
Researchers demonstrated how to exploit one vulnerability, but CERT-EU said no attacks involving any of the five flaws were reported as of Wednesday.
BTCPay said operators can install the fix through the maintenance settings or their Docker installation. Those using node platforms should update when their platforms make it available. The project also pointed operators unable to update immediately to a temporary workaround.
The emergency update follows two earlier BTCPay Server security incidents involving a separate vulnerability that attackers exploited to steal crypto.
In August, attackers exploited a flaw to obtain credentials for Lightning Network nodes and steal funds. In November, BTCPay reported Bitcoin and Litecoin hot-wallet thefts on outdated software, saying attackers had used a different method to exploit the August flaw.
Related: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
items.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws

Cloudflare重做信息提取模型Clairic：从9B升级27B，新增PDF识别并开源

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Cloudflare 发布新版信息提取模型 Clairic，并推出轻量版 Clairic-flash。两款模型分别基于 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 开发，均已开源模型权重及推理代码，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

Clairic 此前于 10 月推出 9B 预览版，主要用于从文字、图片中提取金额、日期、订单号等数据，也能进行简单计算和预测。这次主模型升级至 27B，新增 PDF 识别，最多可同时处理 4 页 PDF 或图片，还能更准确地识别表格、清单等复杂内容。

Cloudflare 还重新设计了信息提取方式。旧版一次计算就给出结果，新版允许多个字段并行逐步生成答案，以少量速度损失换取更高准确率。

官方自测中，在包含文字和图片的合成收据测试里，旧版正确提取了 576 个字段中的 369 个，新版则全部答对。9B 的 Clairic-flash 在同一测试中也全部答对，处理普通文本字段的中位延迟约为 155 毫秒，27B 版则为 358 毫秒。

两款模型现已上线 Workers AI，12 月 1 日前均按每百万输入 Token 0.10 美元收费。此后 27B 版涨至 0.24 美元，9B 版维持 0.10 美元，均不收取输出 Token 费用。

items.content:
Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.
Bitcoin (BTC) rebounded from $62,000 on Thursday as US stock futures rose after Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO.
Key points:
- Bitcoin dropped to $62,000 late Wednesday before rebounding to $63,801 on Thursday.
- Anthropic priced the largest IPO on record at $83 a share, above its initial range of $70 to $78.
- On average, older Bitcoin moved at a lower price than when it last changed hands onchain.
Anthropic’s $81.3 billion IPO tops SpaceX’s record
BTC/USD fell to $62,000 shortly before Wednesday’s daily close, testing the level for the second time this week, TradingView data showed.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Anthropic priced 980 million shares at $83 each on Wednesday, above its initial range of $70 to $78. The $81.3 billion offering surpassed the $75 billion record SpaceX set in June. Anthropic shares are set to begin trading Thursday on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.
Nasdaq 100 futures were up about 1.1% early Thursday. In Seoul, the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) briefly reached 5,100.
KOSPI one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
“All of us have a sincere conviction that the AI exponential will generate so much value that, in the long run, it will far outweigh any shorter-term economic sacrifices we make as part of our mission,” Anthropic wrote in its founders’ letter.
Bitcoin onchain losses continue to mount
Bitcoin saw modest relief from sell-side pressure during the Asia trading session, returning to circle $63,500.
Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today
Wednesday saw net outflows of $306.5 million from the US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), the largest single-day net outflow since Nov. 6, according to Farside Investors.
US spot Bitcoin ETF netflows (screenshot). Source: Farside Investors
Older coins were also moving at a loss, according to an analysis by XWIN Japan published on CryptoQuant.
The analysis tracked Bitcoin that had stayed put for more than 155 days. Over the seven days through Tuesday, those coins moved at prices about 6% lower, on average, than when they last moved.
Bitcoin LTH-SOPR chart. Source: CryptoQuant
Moving Bitcoin between an investor’s own wallets also counts as a transfer, so some of those coins may never have been sold.
Short-term holders also moved coins at a loss. Their ratio fell to 0.955 on Monday, its lowest since February, Cointelegraph previously reported.

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Aave App added Tron USDT deposits as it opened Android early access, with availability varying by region.
- Aave lists Arbitrum for stablecoin withdrawals, and the Tron launch announcement covers deposits.
- The Stable Vault issues a dollar-denominated claim before paying an eligible token, subject to local liquidity and redemption limits.
Aave Labs added Tron USDT deposits to the Aave App on Nov. 17 as it opened early access on Android.
The new route lets eligible users fund the app’s savings vault with Tether’s stablecoin, and Aave lists Arbitrum as a withdrawal option.
Aave’s product page lists USDT, USDC and GHO alongside its Arbitrum withdrawal option. The rollout announced Tron as a funding network and left native Tron USDT payouts unconfirmed.
TRON DAO said eligible users in supported jurisdictions can make the deposits on both Android and iOS. New Android users can download the app and join a waitlist, or use a Ghost Pass to start sooner, according to Aave Labs’ launch announcement.
Under Aave’s app disclosures, a user sends a supported stablecoin from an external wallet to the address the app provides. Funds that reach the user’s self-custodial account enter the pooled Stable Vault under the user’s signed instructions.
The vault checks the deposit asset’s price, issues shares, and records the position in a unit nominally worth one US dollar.
The vault keeps its balance and withdrawal records on Arbitrum. Aave’s technical documentation identifies Ethereum mainnet as a chain where the vault can deploy funds to earn yield.
The pooled funds can move between approved strategies as deposits and withdrawals change the vault’s balances.
What turns a claim into a payout
The withdrawal request burns vault shares and creates a dollar-denominated claim, which Aave calls an IOU. Under the vault’s redemption rules, users can convert principal into that claim.
Converting accrued interest requires the vault to have enough assets, above what it already owes, to cover the interest being claimed.
Settlement burns the IOU and pays out a supported token. The vault needs enough of that token on the payout chain, and a system-wide limit controls how much users can redeem over a given period.
The redemption policy can also apply a fee that varies by asset. For example, a withdrawal in USDC depends on how much USDC is available on the redemption network, even if the saver originally funded the account with USDT.
A token payout goes to a wallet address the user has pre-authorized with a one-time code. Eligible users can separately withdraw to a linked bank account through a separate service that converts stablecoins to conventional currency.
Aave Labs says users can request withdrawals at any time without a lockup. The app’s disclosures say market stress, a shortage of available liquidity or problems with a bridge can delay settlement or make it temporarily unavailable. The rollout gave no settlement timetable for Tron-funded withdrawals.
The Aave DAO earns a fee from the gap between what the vault earns and what it credits to savers, but third-party charges may also apply. Network or swap costs can arise separately if the withdrawal involves converting one stablecoin into another.
In its Nov. 13 report, Aave Labs said user balances across the app had passed $45 million before the Tron rollout. DefiLlama’s Nov. 18 snapshot valued USDT on Tron at $91.7 billion, capturing the USDT supply on the funding network at that valuation.
Aave Labs advertised up to 7.25% annual yield in its launch post, subject to variable rates and eligibility. Aave’s separate Balance Protection program offers discretionary coverage for eligible users, subject to program limits.
Tether is +0.03% over the past 24 hours and currently sits at rank #3 by market cap.
items.title: Aave App taps $91B Tron liquidity as it opens Android early access

分析：BTC复刻上一轮熊市底部特征，MVRV Z-Score再次逼近零轴

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，分析师 Axel Adler Jr 指出，比特币的 MVRV Z-Score 在过去一周内从 0.66 大幅下降至 0.30。当该指标降至零时，意味着比特币的当前市值正好等于其已实现市值（即全市场平均持仓成本）。从历史数据来看，上一次该指标跌破零轴是在 2022 年 11 月至 2023 年 1 月期间，当时该指标在零轴下方连续停留了 68 天。

作为衡量资产估值偏离度的关键指标，MVRV Z-Score 逼近零轴表明，比特币的市场估值正在经历极度压缩，价格已极其接近甚至即将跌破全市场的平均持仓成本。在经历近期的持续下跌后，这一指标的快速回落暗示市场可能正在进入深度低估区域，复刻上一轮熊市底部的特征。

勒布朗·詹姆斯起诉Bron应用：AI广告虚假暗示其使用Kalshi

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，NBA 球星勒布朗·詹姆斯与 LBJ Trademarks LLC 已于 11 月 17 日向纽约南区联邦地区法院提起诉讼，被告为 AI 体育预测研究应用 Bron 的运营方 PlayVision 及其联合创始人 Anish Gupta、Marc Zoghby。诉状称，Gupta 于 11 月 4 日在 X 发布一则广告，使用带有詹姆斯体型、纹身和声音的 AI 生成形象，身穿印有「Bron」和 23 号的球衣，并以其声音说出「Dillon Brooks? On Kalshi? Hell nah」，画面中还出现 Kalshi 与 DraftKings 上的盈利标识。诉状称该广告约一天内在 X 获得约 100 万次观看，并虚假暗示詹姆斯使用与其独家合作伙伴 Polymarket 直接竞争的预测市场平台，同时暗示其参与预测 NBA 比赛，而这为联盟规则所禁止。

詹姆斯的律师于 11 月 5 日发出停止侵权函后，Gupta 当晚回复称已撤下相关材料，并正在为应用更名。广告随后被删除，但应用一度仍使用 Bron 名称，此后已更名为 Evie。诉状认为更名不足以弥补此前对詹姆斯品牌的利用，请求禁止继续使用 Bron 名称、移交域名，并向用户告知其与该公司并无关联，同时索赔包括惩罚性赔偿在内的未具体披露损失。Bron 方面暂未回应置评请求。

分析：比特币表观需求创年内新低，极度恐慌情绪暗藏逆向机会

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，CryptoQuant 分析师 Darkfost 指出，比特币的表观需求已降至 2026 年以来的最低水平，表明当前市场的兴趣甚至弱于今年 7 月的底部时期。该指标曾跌破-29 万枚 BTC，目前略有好转至-25.5 万枚 BTC，但仍远低于-17.2 万枚 BTC 的月度均值。这直观反映了当前的市场状态：投资者充满恐惧，并持续预期比特币将进一步下跌，即便该指标已触及极端水平。

分析师解释称，表观需求通过计算新 BTC 发行量与一年以上未移动供应量之间的差值，来衡量结构性买盘是否足以吸收网络产生的新抛压。值得注意的是，随着 8 月底以来全网算力增长超 13%，新供应正在增加，这需要更强劲的需求来承接。同时，短期持有者（STH）正承受沉重亏损。极端的负面情绪往往值得高度关注，当市场情绪跌至如此谷底时，采取逆向看多的视角或许能带来更丰厚的回报。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378165
items.title: 分析：比特币表观需求创年内新低，极度恐慌情绪暗藏逆向机会

以太坊社区新草案提议动态合并激励：验证者数量高于目标时扣减余额

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，研究员 Anders Elowsson 向以太坊 EIPs 仓库提交一份草案，拟通过动态的「个人合并激励」，推动质押者将质押合并到更少的验证者。提案称，最终确定性成本随验证者数量而非质押总量上升，当前约有 81.5 万个验证者，平均有效余额仅约 54 ETH，已制约更快最终确定性。机制为每个纪元从验证者余额中扣减一笔费用，32 ETH 验证者最高可扣至其全部证明奖励，并随有效余额线性下降，至 2048 ETH 时为零。

验证者数量目标将在约 1.5 年内由起始值线性降至终端值后保持不变，示例分别为约 52.4 万和约 13.1 万。数量高于目标时，该费用按差距逐步上升，低于目标时以约 10 倍速度回落，若合并跟上日程则保持为零。该草案仍为 Draft，依赖已生效的 EIP-7251，激活参数尚未最终确定，编辑已建议编号为 EIP-8502。

谷歌世界模型Genie 4向Ultra用户开放：AI世界能边玩边改，还能分享给其他人

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google DeepMind 将新一代世界模型 Genie 4 接入 Project Genie，开始向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放。Project Genie 是谷歌今年 1 月推出的网页应用，用户可以通过文字或图片创建虚拟世界，再用键盘控制角色，在 AI 实时生成的场景中自由探索。

Genie 4 加入了原生音频，能随着画面变化实时生成环境声、音乐和人物对话。用户还可以在探索过程中输入文字，随时改变天气、添加角色或触发事件，让虚拟世界按照自己的想法不断变化。

Project Genie 还新增了 AI 创作助手。之前用户需要自己描述场景、调整初始画面和视角，现在可以直接通过聊天设计世界，让 AI 自动生成初始场景和配乐。进入世界后，Gemini 还能持续观察画面，推荐下一步探索方向，甚至自动触发场景中的事件。

上一代 Genie 3 也获得升级，单次探索时长从 60 秒延长至 3 分钟，还能把多个虚拟世界连接起来，连续探索不同场景。用户也可以上传 360 度全景照片，让 AI 根据真实环境生成可探索的空间。

Project Genie 同时新增社区作品库，用户可以分享自己创建的世界，其他人可以直接进入探索，也能修改场景、音乐和规则，制作自己的版本。

美国12州已起诉OpenAI，亚利桑那再启动刑事调查：AI疑似闯入银行

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 18 日，美国亚利桑那州总检察长 Kris Mayes 宣布，已对 OpenAI 及其他 AI 公司启动刑事调查，原因是疑似有失控的 AI 智能体侵入银行系统。检方正在调查这些行为是否持续违反州法律。

美国银行业此前已开始防范类似风险。多家大型银行正在拦截外部 AI 智能体进入客户账户、执行交易。有些用户主动把账号密码交给 AI，但智能体可能在没有明确指令的情况下自行操作账户。银行因此开始限制这类访问。

OpenAI 面临的州级法律行动也在迅速增加。截至 11 月 19 日，美国已有 12 个州的总检察长正式起诉 OpenAI。此前多数诉讼围绕 ChatGPT 误导消费者、危害未成年人等问题展开。亚利桑那州自己也在 10 月参与了八州联合发起的诉讼行动。

11 月 16 日，加州又因为 OpenAI 实验性智能体突破隔离、攻击 Hugging Face 等外部系统，将公司告上法庭，要求法院强制整改模型研发中的安全问题。一天后，俄勒冈州也起诉 OpenAI，指控其危害未成年人，并提出超过 20 亿美元的索赔。

亚利桑那州这次进一步启动了刑事调查，调查范围还包括其他 AI 公司。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Invesco’s IROXX fund records shares on Ethereum and initially targets institutions, including stablecoin issuers.
- Superstate normally sends same-day dollar wires for valid fund business-day requests received before the cutoff.
- Shareholders can choose USDC proceeds through a third party that sets its own conversion and delivery terms.
Invesco announced a government money market fund on Nov. 17 that gives eligible institutions a way to hold part of their stablecoin reserves in fund shares recorded on Ethereum.
If a stablecoin issuer needs dollars from the fund to pay customers, it has to redeem those shares on the fund’s business-day schedule.
The Invesco Stablecoin Reserves Onchain Fund (IROXX) is initially aimed at institutions such as stablecoin issuers and digital asset infrastructure providers. Its shares represent an investment in short-duration US Treasury securities and other eligible reserve assets. Holding a stablecoin alone gives a customer no right to redeem shares in the fund.
Investors in supported jurisdictions need an approved Superstate account and a verified wallet on the allowlist to hold IROXX on the Ethereum network.
The standard initial minimum is $1 million per fund account, and Invesco or an intermediary can combine master accounts and subaccounts to meet it.
When the stablecoin wire goes out
To redeem, shareholders submit a request through the Investor Portal run by Superstate, the fund’s sub-transfer agent.
Under the fund’s redemption terms, Superstate normally sends a dollar wire on the next business day if it receives a valid request before 5 p.m. Eastern. For a request received after the cutoff on a business day, the fund normally prices the redemption and sends the wire on the next business day.
The price is the next net asset value per share calculated after Superstate receives the request in good order. The ordinary payment terms allow up to seven days after Superstate receives a request in good order.
Early closes can affect same-day payment, and the fund can also withhold same-day payment in the 30 minutes before it calculates the share price.
A fund business day depends on the New York Fed, the fund’s custodian, and its main portfolio markets being open. Management also has to judge that the market can handle purchase and redemption requests.
Shareholders pay blockchain transaction fees, known as gas, on redemptions. Congestion or insufficient gas can delay a request past the cutoff even if the shareholder starts the transaction before it.
Investors can also elect USDC proceeds through a third-party intermediary, with the service setting its own onboarding and conversion terms, including when it delivers the tokens. The fund’s normal wire schedule gives investors a timetable for when dollars are sent, while USDC delivery depends on the intermediary.
That leaves a gap for a stablecoin issuer drawing on IROXX to plan for if customers seek dollars after the fund’s cutoff. Paying them before the next wire goes out depends on the liquidity the issuer already has available.
items.title: Invesco moves stablecoin reserves on-chain, but hides a liquidity gap

items.author: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi
items.content:
Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.
Bitcoin carry trades could regain their edge over US Treasury bills in 2027 as demand for leverage recovers, according to digital asset bank Sygnum.
In its 2027 Sygnal Outlook report, Sygnum forecasts that the annualized premium on three-month Bitcoin (BTC) futures at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange would average more than 2% above three-month US Treasury bill yields next year.
A crypto carry trade involves buying Bitcoin while betting against its price through futures contracts. This helps limit exposure to Bitcoin’s price swings while also allowing traders to collect funding payments or futures premiums.
Fabian Dori, chief investment officer at Sygnum, told Cointelegraph that returns could recover as investors become more willing to take risks and fewer hedge funds compete for the same profits.
“The basis trade had become very crowded, with many hedge funds running it through spot ETFs [exchange-traded funds] against short CME futures,” Dori said. “Positioning data indicates that those funds have now unwound much of their CME short positions, so there is less capital competing for the same premium.”
Why Bitcoin carry returns fell
Sygnum cited a 67-day stretch of negative Bitcoin funding rates in 2026. It also comes as crypto tech and infrastructure company Talos recently published research showing how much returns have fallen.
In its latest report, Talos said Bitcoin funding rates and futures premiums, which reached peak annualized levels of 20%-40% in early 2024, dropped to just 3%-5% this year. The current three-month US Treasury bill yield is around 4.25%, which means traders can earn about the same return from government debt without taking on the extra risks of crypto trading.
Bitcoin perpetual funding rates and the 30-day futures basis, annualized, 2024-2026. Source: Talos CM Market Data Pro
Sygnum’s forecast now raises the question of whether Bitcoin carry trades can make enough money to justify the risks, such as sudden drops in returns and higher trading costs. And while returns have started to improve, it’s unclear whether that will continue into 2027.
Bitcoin carry trades became popular after the launch of US spot Bitcoin ETFs in 2024, which gave larger investors an easier way to use the strategy. But as more investors entered the market, the returns available from these trades began to fall.
“A more mature market pays less for the same trade,” Dori said. “But it also attracts additional investors, which may increase the demand for leverage.”
According to Talos, Bitcoin funding rates turned negative briefly in the second quarter of the year. This meant that traders betting against Bitcoin through perpetual futures had to pay traders betting on higher prices — as opposed to collecting payments.
Related: Bitcoin ETF inflows leave institutional demand unclear: CoinShares
Bitcoin funding shows tentative recovery
Still, there have been signs of a recovery: Talos found that crypto funding rates have started to rise again since August, potentially supporting Sygnum’s prediction. Coinbase also said in a Nov. 2 report that Bitcoin funding rates rose from around 4% annualized at the start of October to an average of 8.9% annualized in the last week of the month.
Coinbase questioned whether the increase reflected meaningful demand for leveraged Bitcoin trades; it cited weaker buying activity in the spot market.
“It’s less clear to us that the late rise in BTC leverage reflects conviction, given how little support it had from spot holders or the options market,” Coinbase’s report reads.
Sygnum expects wider institutional adoption to support demand for leveraged Bitcoin exposure in 2027. It pointed to factors such as growing institutional investment in Bitcoin, the growth of tokenization and rising demand for AI.
However, Dori warned that a sharp market downturn, a shortage of liquidity, or interest rates staying higher for longer could prevent carry trade returns from recovering. He also pointed to risks that come with increased leveraged trading. Even a hedged position can face margin calls, requiring traders to post more collateral or close their futures position.
“Carry can pay steadily for long periods and then turn quickly,” he said. “When positioning gets crowded and funding reverses, the unwind is typically fast, because the same leverage that pays the carry forces the exit.”
Magazine: Why US-regulated Bitcoin perpetuals could change crypto trading
items.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts

以太坊sBOLD金库遭340万美元攻击，区块构建者获得约178万美元费用

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，K3 Capital 旗下 sBOLD 储蓄金库周三遭攻击，攻击者通过操纵金库份额核算方式，在约 8 分钟内转移约 340 万美元资产。Bitquery 追踪了清空金库的 97 笔交易，数据显示，参与抢跑攻击交易的机器人向以太坊区块构建者支付约 178 万美元。

攻击者通过反复存入 BOLD、引入最初未纳入金库核算的封装 ETH，再将其兑换为 BOLD，以虚高的份额价值赎回资产。该操作可在单笔交易中重复执行，从而提取其他存款人的资金。其中，一个自动交易机器人复制攻击过程，提取约 191 万美元，占被盗资金的 56%，但为抢在竞争对手之前打包交易，向区块构建者支付了大部分收益。Titan 构建了包含该机器人交易的大部分区块，BuilderNet、Ultrasound 和 Quasar 也参与处理。

178 万美元属于区块构建者收到的付款，并非已确认利润，因为构建者还需向验证者支付费用。原始攻击者及其资助的钱包最终合计获得约 52 万美元。ChainSecurity 曾于 2025 年 5 月审计 sBOLD，并指出一种可通过自我清算提取价值的方式，但目前尚不清楚此次攻击是否利用了相关机制。

items.content:
Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.
Six bipartisan senators on Tuesday urged the US Treasury Department to extend proposed regulatory protections to state-supervised stablecoin issuers, warning that proposed GENIUS Act rules could steer firms toward federal licenses.
In a letter to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Senators Cynthia Lummis and Kirsten Gillibrand, along with Angela Alsobrooks, Kevin Cramer, Pete Ricketts and Mark Warner, said Treasury’s proposal offers a safe harbor to certain issuers with pending federal applications and regulator-approved waivers, but no equivalent protection for state issuers.
The senators warned that issuers “may be incentivized to seek greater operational clarity under a federal license,” including through the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), which they said was “the opposite of our intent in drafting this legislation.”
The senators urged Treasury to extend the safe harbor to issuers in states expected to have qualifying frameworks in place before Jan. 18, 2028, reducing uncertainty while certification reviews are pending.
The senators’ request follows a June appeal, urging Treasury to preserve state participation and clarify the certification process.
The GENIUS Act generally allows issuers with $10 billion or less in outstanding stablecoins to operate under qualifying state supervision, with exemptions available above that threshold.
Kevin Wysocki, head of policy at Anchorage Digital, questioned whether a broader safe harbor would make much difference. He said issuers are choosing federal oversight because they risk having to switch regulators if their stablecoins exceed $10 billion in circulation, although exemptions are available.
Related: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
items.title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight

三名前OpenAI研究员创业18个月，靠企业定制AI拿下45亿美元收购协议

动察 Beating AI 快讯，网络安全巨头 Palo Alto Networks 宣布，拟以 45 亿美元全股票收购 AI 初创公司 Applied Compute。这家公司 11 月 2 日刚完成 3.5 亿美元融资，估值达到 32.5 亿美元。

Applied Compute 由 3 名前 OpenAI 研究人员创立，成立仅约 18 个月，目前约有 70 名员工。公司称，年化营收运行率已达到约 1 亿美元。

Applied Compute 专门帮企业训练自己的 AI 模型。它以开放权重模型为基础，用企业的业务数据进一步训练，再负责部署和持续改进。例如，它为法律 AI 公司 Harvey 定制的模型，在提高回答和引用质量的同时，将推理成本降到了某款前沿模型的一半以下。它还为 Clay 训练了模型路由系统，最高降低 47% 的推理成本。

Palo Alto Networks 原本主要提供网络安全产品，如今准备进一步涉足企业 AI 模型的训练与运行，让客户既能使用自己的专属模型，也能获得配套的安全防护。Applied Compute 创始人 Yash Patil 将在交易完成后担任联合首席 AI 官。

根据收购方披露，45 亿美元交易对价中包含约 5 亿美元的现金及预付算力承诺。交易仍需监管审批，预计于 2027 年 2 月至 4 月完成。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.
Hackers behind the record $6.3 billion Binance hack stole a total of 192 cryptocurrencies across 11 blockchain networks, new court documents reveal.
The figures come from an asset schedule submitted by Nest Clearing and Custody Limited, which operated the affected Binance wallets, and included in a Wednesday Abu Dhabi court order shared with Cointelegraph.
Tether’s USDt (USDT) accounted for the largest share of stolen value at $2.50 billion, followed by $1.42 billion in Bitcoin (BTC) and $826 million in Circle’s USDC (USDC). Together, the three assets made up about 76% of the total value of misappropriated tokens.
While earlier reports identified many of the tokens stolen in the attack, the latest court documents show a full breakdown of all crypto assets stolen in the attack, including the quantities and what they were worth at the time of the theft.
Cointelegraph’s analysis found that fiat-linked stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion, 55% of the assets stolen. Beyond USDt and USDC, the court schedule lists nine other fiat-linked stablecoins.
These included Ripple USD (RLUSD), World Liberty Financial USD (USD1), Ethena USDe (USDE), First Digital USD (FDUSD), Sky Dollar (USDS), StraitsX USD (XUSD), Binance USD (BUSD), Pax Dollar (USDP) and Eurite (EURI). The nine stablecoins were worth $132.4 million combined at the time of the theft.
Stolen memecoins, gold-backed tokens
The Binance hackers also stole $37.9 million in memecoins, led by $34.9 million in Pepe (PEPE) and $2.3 million in Shiba Inu (SHIB).
Another $58 million in tokenized gold and more than $5 million across five gaming and metaverse tokens, including The Sandbox (SAND), Axie Infinity (AXS) and Decentraland (MANA), were stolen in the hack. Around $73.5 million of Wrapped Beacon ETH (WBETH) was stolen.
The haul also included $97.4 million across three DeFi tokens, led by $45.1 million in Uniswap’s UNI, followed by $37.3 million in Ethena’s ENA and $15.1 million in Aave’s AAVE.
Meanwhile, Ethereum accounted for roughly 60% of the stolen assets by value, more than any other blockchain network.
Related: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
Abu Dhabi court to hear bid for frozen assets on Dec. 1
Cointelegraph previously reported that the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts issued a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing injunction against the unidentified people accused of carrying out the attack.
The order restricts them from dealing with assets up to that value and requires them to disclose worldwide assets worth more than $50,000 in sworn statements by Nov. 30.
A separate order requires 18 named firms, including Circle and BitGo Bank & Trust, to maintain existing freezes on assets linked to the hack.
Court documents show it will consider on Dec. 1 whether to extend that injunction and whether the firms must hand over the assets they froze.
The US Department of Justice said last Thursday it had obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of the $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance.
The authorization covers part of the more than $2.7 billion in stolen assets that US authorities and private-sector partners have frozen since the Oct. 29 hack. Investigators are still working to recover additional funds.
Magazine: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency
items.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show

items.author: jdns
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[cowlevel]: So the recent RCE wave seems to be people finding more single byte overflows and such, but reporting them as RCEs because AI can do the tedious grunt work of finding the rest of the vulnerability chain. If any single byte overflow can be converted into an RCE with minimal human effort then we have no choice but to prove the whole software stack is memory safe.

[circularfoyers]: Thought this was another vulnerability for a second, but for anyone else who thought the same, this is already covered in the Ruby advisory being discussed here  https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50554038  (which covers six other vulnerabilities).

[djha-skin]: I remember being a kid in a small town. My dad got into an auto accident, and the next day the DJs talked about it on the radio. Then we moved to the Chicago area and the morning news only ever talked about  how many  accidents we'd see  that day  on our theoretical morning commute during the traffic segment. At what point will we stop considering individual x2shell ultra-critical CVEs news in the age of AI? Like, how many of these are we finding  per hour ?

[barbegal]: More interested to see how you can use just a single byte overflow to trigger RCE. Definitely achievable but sounds tough.

[t1234s]: For people who haven't been to Germany the character that looks like a script B is pronounced like "S". Its a bit of humor in what is an annoying problem.

Bitunix分析师：AI资本狂热与美债资金分化，市场反弹恐延长紧缩周期

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，Anthropic 上市将 AI 投资热度推向公开市场，散户首日净买入预估达 2.5 亿美元，IPO 定价 83 美元，高于指导区间，反映市场对 AI 龙头仍有强烈追价意愿。然而，公司九个月营收超过 330 亿美元，同比增长 1200%，同时累计支出承诺高达 9000 亿美元，增长与资本需求同步扩张。庞大的融资与基建成本将成为估值能否延续的关键，上市热度并不意味着资金风险消失。

与 AI 资金追逐形成对比，9 月海外美债持仓减少 755 亿美元，降至 9.24 万亿美元的一年低点，日本、英国及中国均有减持，但韩国逆势买入 115 亿美元，创历史纪录，显示全球资金并非一致撤离美元资产，而是在重新调整配置。当美债收益率高企、通胀与财政风险仍未消退，资金流向更反映不同市场对利率与经济前景的判断。

德银指出，中东能源风险、AI 投资降温与欧洲债务压力未必同步恶化，AI 资本支出减少甚至可能降低能源需求、通胀与债券融资压力；但若油价上涨，则可能同时推高通胀、压低增长。更值得注意的是，股市反弹、信用利差收窄将放松金融条件，反而可能让美联储更有理由维持紧缩。对 BTC 及风险资产而言，市场真正需要的不是短暂反弹，而是通胀降温与资金成本下降能否同步发生。

英伟达Blackwell贡献74%的新增AI推理容量，GB300单卡是H100的25倍

动察 Beating AI 快讯，研究机构 Epoch AI 最新估算，英伟达 Blackwell 系列芯片贡献了过去一年全球新增 AI Agent 请求处理能力的 74%。其中，GB300 单卡在特定测试条件下，能够同时处理的 Agent 请求量约为 H100 的 25 倍、H200 的 8 倍。

编程 Agent 需要反复读取代码、保留历史对话、调用工具。芯片除了要进行计算，还要用显存保存大量上下文，并快速读取数据。显存容量、读写带宽，以及多块芯片之间的通信速度，都会影响能同时运行多少个 Agent。

按照传统的每秒计算次数衡量，GB300 的峰值算力仅为 H100 的约 2.5 倍。但综合这些因素后，Epoch AI 估算其 Agent 请求处理能力达到约 25 倍。

从 2025 年第二季度到 2026 年第二季度，全球累计售出 AI 芯片能够同时处理的 Agent 请求量增至原来的 4.6 倍，而同期峰值算力只增至 2.6 倍。

英伟达临时 CEO Colette Kress 在 11 月 17 日的财报电话会上确认，公司已停止向中国出货获许可的 Hopper 系列数据中心芯片，包括 H200。华为则计划在 2027 年第一季度推出昇腾 960DT，公布的 FP8 峰值算力规格接近 H200。

- Binance listed IBITUSDT on Nov. 18 with round-the-clock trading and a launch leverage ceiling of 20x.
- When vendor quotes are unavailable on weekends and holidays, the futures order book supplies the index inputs.
- Binance uses its mark price to trigger liquidation, and that price can move while the ETF market is closed.
Binance Futures added a perpetual contract tied to BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) on Nov. 18.
The contract (IBITUSDT) gives eligible traders round-the-clock exposure to the Nasdaq-listed fund, settles in Tether’s USDT, and offered up to 20x leverage at launch.
Binance set the opening for 09:45 UTC in a listing notice, and the exchange’s public futures ticker recorded trades after the scheduled opening. The contract keeps trading after the fund’s market closes, and Binance’s mark price can still move far enough to trigger liquidation.
Traders can take a position on IBIT's rise or fall without owning its shares or Bitcoin, as the fund seeks to reflect Bitcoin's price.
Binance’s TradFi FAQ lists the UK, Hong Kong, Taiwan and some European Economic Area countries as common examples of restricted markets for these products. The 20x figure is the launch ceiling, and Binance’s margin rules set lower leverage ceilings for larger positions.
How Binance prices IBIT exposure after hours
The price index is Binance’s reference for the underlying and helps feed the mark price, the estimate the exchange uses to determine whether a position has reached its liquidation threshold.
During regular equity trading, Binance builds its reference index from third-party price quotes. It smooths those quotes during premarket and after-hours trading, then gives new quotes less weight during the overnight session, according to Binance’s pricing methodology.
On weekends, holidays, and during covered maintenance periods without those quotes, Binance looks to the futures order book, where traders place buy and sell orders for the perpetual.
It averages two measures from that book, the impact bid and impact ask, then smooths the result by giving more weight to recent readings. The index can keep moving while the ETF’s last share price stays where trading left it.
The index feeds the mark, which Binance calculates separately from the latest executed trade.
If an adverse move leaves too little collateral to keep the position open, Binance can forcibly close it while the ETF market is shut. Under Binance’s liquidation rules, the mark triggers that process when it reaches the position’s liquidation threshold.
Binance normally limits the weekend and holiday gap between the mark and the index to 3% in either direction for equity-linked perpetuals and can adjust the limit in extreme conditions.
A trader can be right about where IBIT shares will reopen and still be forced out of the perpetual over the weekend if Binance’s mark crosses the liquidation level first.

新加坡发行1亿新元代币化票据，拟建立统一身份验证协议监管AI代理金融风险

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据彭博社报道，新加坡金融管理局（MAS）局长 Chia Der Jiun 表示，AI 代理可能以更快速度转移资金和配置资产，即使激励金额较小，也可能引发新的流动性及金融稳定风险，金融机构可能需要对 AI 代理发起的交易设置限额，监管机构也需评估其对金融稳定的影响。

Chia Der Jiun 同时警告，不应向个人 AI 代理提供金融账户登录凭证，目前尚无法充分确保其安全性。新加坡金管局计划制定统一的「了解你的代理」（Know Your Agent）协议，供银行和支付服务商核实 AI 代理的身份、权限及授权范围，并将测试利用 AI 代理监控流动性头寸，以及通过代币化存款或稳定币执行支付。

此外，新加坡金管局本月已发行 1 亿新元（约 7800 万美元）的代币化票据（MAS Bills），并使用新加坡元央行数字货币完成结算，未来将与行业合作将更多常用抵押品引入数字平台，包括外国政府证券和货币市场基金。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378127

华尔街承诺为英伟达动员5000亿美元融资，至今尚未投放一分钱

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，今年 8 月，英伟达联合 Apollo、Blackstone、BlackRock、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs 和 KKR 等华尔街巨头，宣布计划动员 5000 亿美元，为 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 企业及其他芯片客户提供融资支持，但截至目前，该计划尚未实际投入任何资金。

报道称，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋最初希望与华尔街合作推出规模达 1 万亿美元的融资计划，以帮助信用资质较弱的 AI 初创公司购买英伟达芯片，维持未来芯片销售增长。但各方签署的合作备忘录仅有数页，主要明确融资目标、潜在客户范围，以及英伟达将视具体项目提供信用担保的原则，参与机构并未承诺实际募集资金，5000 亿美元也并非具有约束力的融资承诺。

融资计划迟迟未能落地的关键障碍在于风险分担。英伟达此前表示，愿意提供的信用支持最高不超过项目成本的 25%，而华尔街投资者希望获得更高比例的担保。与此同时，随着信贷市场对 AI 企业偿债能力日益谨慎，金融机构也开始收紧相关融资。

目前，各方仍在讨论首笔以英伟达芯片为抵押的客户融资交易，但预计最快也要到明年才能完成。英伟达临时 CEO、财务主管 Colette Kress 周二表示，公司正在严格评估未来投资、承诺及担保，将更加审慎地参与相关交易。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378121

items.content:
美国拟强制企业公开「用了中国AI」：Airbnb、Cursor已被国会盯上

动察 Beating AI 快讯，特朗普政府正在考虑要求美国企业公开披露使用中国 AI 模型的情况。企业可能需要直接在官网说明自己用了哪些中国模型。

消息人士透露，美国财政部和白宫科技政策办公室已经讨论这一方案。他们不直接禁止企业使用中国 AI，而是通过公开披露带来的声誉和政治压力，劝退美国企业。

有不少知名公司已经被盯上。Airbnb 使用阿里 Qwen 支持 AI 客服，Cursor 的编程模型 Composer 2 基于月之暗面 Kimi K2.5 继续训练，DoorDash 也将部分内部任务交给 Kimi 处理。今年 4 月以来，美国国会已先后向这三家公司发函调查。

美国国会下属的美中经济与安全审查委员会本月还提出了更严格的建议：企业使用中国 AI 必须公开说明，未披露可能面临监管处罚，上市公司还要向 SEC 报告相关风险。委员会甚至建议，未经安全评估和授权，禁止在关键基础设施、国家安全等敏感领域部署中国模型。

中国开源模型正在美国企业中快速普及，主要原因是价格更低、性能足够好，而且方便企业自行修改。Airbnb 回应称，其绝大多数 AI 业务仍使用美国模型，少量中国模型也只通过获批准的美国服务商运行，以隔离和保护数据。

目前，这项披露要求仍处于讨论阶段，尚未成为正式规定。委员会的更严格建议也没有获得立法通过。

谷歌Neon拿下编程Agent世界第一：击败Fable 5.2，任务成本还更低

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌Neon拿下编程Agent世界第一：击败Fable 5.2，任务成本还更低

谷歌刚发布的 Gemini 4 Neon，拿下了 Artificial Analysis 编程智能体（Coding Agent）排行榜第一名，超过了 11 月 9 日才发布的 Claude Fable 5.2。

Neon 搭配 Antigravity CLI，在最高推理档位下取得 58.6 分（榜单四舍五入显示为 59 分），领先搭配 Claude Code 的 Fable 5.2 和 Opus 5.5，后两者均为约 58 分。

这项综合评测包含 FrontierCode-AA 2.0、Terminal-Bench 4.1 和 SWE-Atlas-QnA-AA 三项测试，各占总成绩的三分之一。由于测试的是模型与 Agent 工具的组合，排名也会受到工具本身的影响。

Artificial Analysis 按 API 用量估算，Neon 完成一项编程任务平均花费 6.86 美元，Fable 5.2 为 15.47 美元，Opus 5.5 为 12.61 美元。

另外在 CursorBench 4.1 测试中，Neon 甚至不用开最高推理档，就以 63.7% 的得分超过了 Fable 5.2 最高档的 61.3%，平均每项任务成本仅 6.54 美元，后者却要 48.11 美元。即使把 Neon 也开到最高档，得分进一步升至 65.4%，任务成本也只有 10.67 美元，不到 Fable 5.2 的四分之一。

Gemini 4 Neon 刷新了编程模型的性能与成本「帕累托前沿」。

Skydance CEO证实马斯克已入股公司，称获得其投资是荣幸

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据 Variety 报道，传媒娱乐巨头 Skydance 董事长兼 CEO David Ellison 在周三举行的《纽约时报》2026 DealBook 峰会上证实，马斯克已成为 Skydance 股东，但未披露具体投资金额。此前 CNBC 和 Semafor 报道称，马斯克在 Skydance 与派拉蒙、华纳兄弟探索合并后投资约 10 亿美元。

David Ellison 表示，马斯克是这个时代最伟大的企业家之一，其投资代表了对公司的信任，能够拥有马斯克这样的股东是公司的荣幸。如果未来存在合适的合作机会，公司也将非常乐意与其合作，但目前尚无具体合作计划。

此次表态也引发外界对 Skydance 与马斯克旗下 SpaceX 及 Starlink 未来合作的猜测。David Ellison 同时确认，Skydance 仍计划于 2027 年第一季度在 HBO Max 上线马斯克纪录片《Musk》。

「AI股神」Leopold计划重启基金，拟重新使用杠杆并寻求外部融资

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 19 日，据英国《金融时报》报道，25 岁的 AI 投资人、Situational Awareness 创始人 Leopold Aschenbrenner 正计划在基金经历近乎致命的亏损事件仅四个月后重启业务，新计划被称为「Situational Awareness 2.0」。据知情人士透露，Aschenbrenner 近期已与投资者及主经纪商讨论重新开展杠杆交易，并计划于明年初寻求外部融资。

今年夏季，Situational Awareness 因押注 AI 股票遭遇巨额亏损，管理资产规模曾超过 200 亿美元，随后在数日内被迫与 Citadel 达成紧急协议，以折价出售绝大部分公开市场持仓，并偿还高盛、摩根大通等贷款方。目前基金仍管理超过 100 亿美元资产，主要为私人投资，其中持有约 50 亿美元 Anthropic 股份。

报道称，Aschenbrenner 此前曾与 Jefferies 洽谈开设主经纪账户，但该银行今年早些时候因认为基金对冲不足而拒绝合作。基金目前还与专业经纪商 Clear Street 合作，并正在寻找首席风险官。目前团队约有 30 名员工。

此次重启计划恰逢 Anthropic 筹备 IPO。Situational Awareness 持有的 Anthropic 股份预计将在上市后大幅升值。不过，重新使用杠杆及引入外部资金的计划尚未最终敲定。此前 Aschenbrenner 曾在 7 月向投资者承认管理失误，并表示基金已停止通过银行借贷放大投资头寸。
